globaltix_product_data.description: Make the most of your visit to Thailand by participating in this tour combining entertainment with charity. Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is a project allows you to turn your kindness into practical use and have tons of fun at the same time. Venture to a natural paradise featuring picturesque scenery and adorable elephants. Enjoy bathing, feeding, playing with them on your visit. Drink in the stunning views of green mountains and powdery beach. Savor the fresh air produced by the primitive jungle. In this extremely pleasant environment, absorb the historical and biological knowledge about these gigantic animals offered by a professional guide fluent in English.
highlights: Have fun in an ethical environment friendly to elephants and spend some unforgettable time together
Get close to these giant and gentle animals, enjoy interaction experiences such as feeding and bathing them
The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is an ethical and sustainable eco-tourism project based in Thailand.
The sanctuary is located in 4 provinces throughout Thailand - Chiang Mai, Phuket, Pattaya, and Koh Samui.
Visitors will have the opportunity to feed, bathe, and play with the elephants.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Château d’Azay-le-Rideau is an innovative blend of 16th-century building styles in the beautiful Loire Valley. Surrounded by 8 hectares of English-style gardens, this French Renaissance castle is as beautiful as it is storied.Sitting pretty on its own island in the Indre River, this historic Château has been here since the reign of Francis I. Constructed between 1518 and 1527, it's just gone through a major restoration to restore the slate roofing and early 16th-century framework. All scrubbed up, it shows off its fresh face and historic trappings. Check out the lavishly furnished rooms, the intricately decorated staircase within the castle walls, and the amazing ceiling decorations. And on the outside, the 19th-century English-style gardens are the perfect place to walk and wait for a bluebird to land on your shoulder.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Arc de Triomphe is a Neoclassical take on the ancient Roman triumphal arch style. Fifty meters tall, the view from the platform atop the arch is well worth the hike. See the dozen Parisian avenues radiating out from the arch into the City of Light. Paris is one of the most fascinating places in the world and you will find yourself right at its center. Inspired by the great arches of ancient Rome, Napoleon commissioned the Arc de Triomphe shortly after his victory at Austerlitz. Unfortunately, he never lived to see its completion. At the base of the arch, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier pays tribute to the 1.3 million French soldiers who died in World War I. Behold the eternal flame that is rekindled at 6.30 PM each evening. In addition, there is a must-see exhibition that explains the symbolic importance of this monument. The view from the top of the arch is worth climbing the 284 stairs. From your privileged position, survey all of Paris. Unlike the obligatory Eiffel Tower trip, getting into the Arc de Triomphe is an effort not all tourists undertake. Please note that the elevator is strictly for disabled people.

globaltix_product_data.description: There's so much to see at this huge outdoor complex, you'll feel like you've ticked off all of Thailand's best bits within a day. Take a stroll around the impressive site and explore smaller versions of Thailand's famous temples, palaces, gardens, floating markets, and much more. There are five park zones to explore, covering different areas of Thailand and a combination of traditional and modern buildings. As you explore, you'll learn all about the history of the country, soak up the unique Ancient City atmosphere, and discover new and traditional cultures, architecture, and arts.
highlights: Explore smaller versions of Thailand's famous temples, palaces, gardens, floating markets, and much more

Explore five distinct park zones, each representing different regions of Thailand and showcasing a blend of traditional and modern architecture
Emphasize the expertise of the guides, who share insights into the history, art, and symbolism of the sites, enriching the visitor experience.
Emphasize the spiritual and artistic experience of visiting the Erawan Museum

globaltix_product_data.summary: Spanning 12.5 acres in the cool, scenic mid-hills of Genting Highlands, our floral, magical land is designed to spark curiosity, joy, and a deep connection to the natural world. Escape to the cool climate of Genting Highlands and experience nature in full bloom, perfect for families, couples, and we...
globaltix_product_data.description: Spanning 12.5 acres in the cool, scenic mid-hills of Genting Highlands, our floral, magical land is designed to spark curiosity, joy, and a deep connection to the natural world. Escape to the cool climate of Genting Highlands and experience nature in full bloom, perfect for families, couples, and weekend explorers. Designed to inspire a deep connection with nature, Eufloria Gardens & Sculpture Park serves as a space for learning, exploration, and wonder, through thoughtfully designed exhibits, interactive tours and educational programmes. Our aim is for visitors to cultivate a sense of awe and respect for the environment while providing a serene escape from everyday life. Let’s rediscover the magic of nature. Explore the GardenZodiac Pavilion See the giant sculptures, feel the mist and marvel at a towering indoor waterfall surrounded by a lush tropical oasis. Rainforest Grove Breathe in the earthy air, admire the lush greenery as you allow the rainforest to revitalise your mind and body. Garden of the Seasons Experience a garden that’s always in bloom. With flowers that change every few months, no two visits are ever the same. Enchanted Orchard Step into a living sanctuary where the air is scented with ripe fruit, and every corner is alive with texture and colour. Here, fruit trees flourish in a space designed to awaken your senses and calm your spirit. Harmony Garden 和园 (He Yuan) A sanctuary of stillness, let its quiet magic restore your spirit and awaken inner peace. The Living Market Learn, explore, and bring home a piece of the garden. Discover essential tools and seedlings for every gardener.
highlights: Let the symphony of nature’s hues and the crisp mountain air transport you to tranquillity and wonder within Eufloria Gardens & Sculpture Park
Engage in educational exhibits, interactive tours, and programmes that promote conservation and environmental awareness.
Discover immersive experiences with giant sculptures, indoor waterfall, lush rainforest, and sensory-rich environments.
Spanning 12.5 acres in the cool mid-hills of Genting Highlands, this floral wonderland inspires curiosity, joy, and a deep connection to nature.
Enjoy serene spaces like Harmony Garden and Enchanted Orchard, blending relaxation, nature, and cultural inspiration.

globaltix_product_data.description: Issued by EZ-Link Pte Ltd, the ez-link card was the very first contactless stored value card introduced for public transit use on the MRT, LRT and buses in April 2002. Due to its contactless nature, the card completes all its transactions within 0.2 seconds and in this way, revolutionarily makes travelling on buses and trains that much faster and smoother. The new ez-link card which is CEPAS* compliant was the first CEPAS card to be launched in Singapore in 2008 and to date, remains the number 1 choice for contactless prepaid card payment in Singapore. Today, the ez-link card has become synonymous with convenient, quick, accurate and secured cashless transactions. Almost every Singaporean carries at least one ez-link card in his or her wallet not just for transit purposes but for all kinds of lifestyle payment needs such as ERP charges, shopping at retail outlets, dining, government services and so much more. *CEPAS stands for Contactless ePurse Applications, a Singapore standard.

Local Experience: Travel like a resident with a widely accepted smart card used daily across Singapore’s transport network

globaltix_product_data.summary: Dive into Portuguese culture with this musical spectacular! It's a TripAdvisor #1-ranked activity in Portugal and a fabulous night out for all!If music be the food of...
globaltix_product_data.description: Dive into Portuguese culture with this musical spectacular! At Fado in Chiado you can watch talented live singers and guitar players on stage, accompanied by multimedia moving images of Lisbon. It's a TripAdvisor #1-ranked activity in Portugal and a fabulous night out for all!If music be the food of love, play on! It's a famous quote for a reason, and we're thinking fado might be it. The live Fado in Chiado is a great way to get to the heart and soul of Portuguese culture, and you don't even need to leave your chair.Fado itself - the poignant musical style - is Portuguese, and the art that's now considered part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO was born in Lisbon. So there's nowhere in the world better to enjoy it!Listen as a talented singer and two musicians work their magic with Portuguese and classical guitars, as moving images of Lisbon conjure up the far reaches of this complex city.The soulful, almost melancholy fado, is said to combine hope with resignation, and melancholy with nostalgia. So go see Fado in Chiado with a loved one, and hold them close; you never know when the love between you might get snuffed out like the flame of a match.
highlights: Experience a cultural highlight with an hour-long live fado show - it's a TripAdvisor #1-ranked activity!
Be mesmerized by the talented singers and Portuguese guitar players in a unique Lisbon venue
See an art that's actually been included as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO

globaltix_product_data.description: Madame Tussauds Singapore is an interactive wax museum and immersive attraction located at Imbiah Lookout. It combines lifelike celebrity figures, engaging storytelling, and themed experiences into one exciting journey. Guests can meet global icons, explore Singapore’s rich heritage, and enjoy unique attractions like the Marvel 4D Experience and Ultimate Film Star Experience, making it a must-visit for visitors of all ages. Guests are recommended to spend 2–3 hours exploring the attraction. The experience is largely self-paced, allowing visitors to move through each zone freely, while selected highlights such as the Marvel 4D show may run on scheduled timings. The total duration may vary depending on crowd levels and time spent at each interactive exhibit. Upon arrival, guests can enter via QR code e-ticket or redeem vouchers at the counter. The journey typically begins with Images of Singapore LIVE, where visitors are immersed in the nation’s history through interactive, actor-led storytelling. Guests then proceed through the wax galleries, posing with incredibly realistic figures of celebrities such as Johnny Depp, Nicole Kidman, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Muhammad Ali. The experience continues at the Marvel 4D Experience, where guests can interact with superheroes, try on Iron Man’s armor, and take photos with Spider-Man before enjoying a dynamic 4D film. The visit concludes with the Ultimate Film Star Experience, where guests step into cinematic sets and enjoy a behind-the-scenes journey into the life of a movie star, creating a fun and memorable finale.

Travel up the path pass Subway and turn right to reach the red carpets of Madame Tussauds Singapore By Cable Car: From Harbourfront MRT station, make your way to the Cable Car Station at Harbourfront Tower 2. Hop on the Cable Car and alight at Sentosa Station. Exit the gift shop and follow the path along Samundar Express on the left to reach the red carpets of Madame Tussauds Singapore

globaltix_product_data.description: Welcome to "Fantastic Phuket" a captivating Phuket attraction filled with living history! Under the concept of "Minimize Thailand in Phuket," this destination is a hub of knowledge and entertainment, featuring popular photo spots and trendy check-in points. Here, you can immerse yourself in the charm of Phuket Old Town and experience Thai culture from a truly unique perspective. The moment you step inside, you’ll feel as if you’ve traveled back in time, exploring stories from the era of ancient kingdoms to the formation of Siam and modern-day Thailand. The site showcases ancient artifacts, replicas of historical landmarks, and artistic representations of diverse Thai cultural heritage. Adding to the experience, cutting-edge lighting, sound, and AR technology bring mythical realms to life, from the grandeur of heaven and the depths of the underworld to the mystical creatures of Himmapan Forest. You can also explore the Thai folklore zone, where local beliefs and legends create an exciting and immersive adventure. Fantastic Phuket is more than just another tourist spot, it’s a must-visit destination that breathes new life into Thai history and art. Visit once, and you’ll fall in love with its enchanting charm!

globaltix_product_data.description: An Eden of Nature and Animals Farm In The City (FITC) is a unique new concept that combines elements of wildlife and nature set in a designed environment of a conservation park. Drawing upon the values of Malaysia’s multi-racial and multi-cultural population, FITC is designed to resemble a typical Malaysia village or “kampung” setting. FITC plans to become a focal point for tourism in the state by providing educational and entertaining insight into the lifestyle and setting of a Malaysian village, farm and fruit orchard with its natural plants and wildlife. FITC is much more than a viewing exhibit. It encourages visitor-interactions with the animals and plant-life in a comfortable yet authentic environment. FITC also places great importance on education of visitors on the various aspects of farm and animal life as well as wildlife conservation and preservation.

globaltix_product_data.summary: “Have I really been here for three hours?” - this might be the only question left unanswered after your visit to this brand new attraction in the heart of Amsterdam. globaltix_product_data.description: “Have I really been here for three hours?” - this might be the only question left unanswered after your visit to this brand new attraction in the heart of Amsterdam. There’s so much to see and do that you’ll wish you had four eyes, like a certain Chinese gentleman you'll meet. Step into this delightful time sink - and good luck with that @#$%&! mystery gate!Robert Ripley toured the world, returning with surprising information and peculiar artifacts. At Ripley’s Believe It or Not Amsterdam you can benefit from his years of hard work as you wander the five floors of (nearly) unbelievable artifacts. Start at the entrance, by taking a selfie with the world’s tallest man. And then dive deeper and deeper into a comprehensive collection of fascinating oddities. From a Ghanese coffin in the shape of a flying car, to an intricate sculpture made entirely of cutlery, this exhibition will beguile, baffle and delight. Plus, if you’re scared of the dentist, the terrifying 19th century tooth extractor will show just how good you have it! Altogether, there are more than 500 exhibits and artifacts organized in 19 themed galleries - but don't worry, there's a clear path guiding you through the building. You can spend as much time as you want analyzing the contents of each room before moving to the next one. Learn how to shrink a human head in the jungle gallery, then go to the creepy chamber (unless you're too chicken) and see which torture enthusiast inspired Bram Stoker to create Count Dracula.Whether you’re familiar with curator Robert Ripley’s legacy or not, this place will grab your attention and hold onto it for hours. Say hello to weirdness, and goodbye to whatever else you had planned for the afternoon.

Explore 19 themed galleries packed full of curious delights and wax figures of real people that Mr. Ripley encountered in the 201 countries he visited
Interact with dozens of attractions, like the brain-twisting vortex tunnel, the shooting gallery, and the rage-inducing mystery gate

The attraction combines a zoo, botanical environment, educational exhibits, and interactive animal experiences across spacious outdoor and indoor areas. Visitors can discover wild...
globaltix_product_data.description: Faunia is a nature and wildlife park located in Madrid, Spain, designed around immersive ecosystems and themed habitats. The attraction combines a zoo, botanical environment, educational exhibits, and interactive animal experiences across spacious outdoor and indoor areas. Visitors can discover wildlife from around the world while exploring carefully recreated climates and environments in a family-friendly setting. The park features more than 1,200 animals from over 150 species spread across 15 themed areas and four major ecosystems, including the Jungle, Polar Ecosystem, African Forest, and Mediterranean habitats. Guests can see king penguins, Komodo dragons, manatees, lemurs, sea lions, flamingos, and tropical birds while enjoying educational talks, feeding sessions, and interactive experiences. The Polar Ecosystem is especially known for being one of Europe’s largest penguin habitats. Most guests spend between half a day and a full day exploring the attraction depending on their pace and participation in scheduled activities. Entry is available through printed or mobile tickets, and the visit follows a self-guided format with clearly marked routes throughout the park. Visitors can take breaks at restaurants, picnic zones, shops, and rest areas while moving between ecosystems and exhibits.

Flexible self-guided experience suitable for families, nature lovers, and wildlife enthusiasts.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience the ultimate adventure with the Nusa Penida West Tour + Manta Snorkeling from Bali, brought to you by Gorilla Adventures Bali. This unique tour combines the best of both worlds: exploring the stunning landscapes of West Nusa Penida and snorkeling with majestic manta rays. Perfect for thri...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the ultimate adventure with the Nusa Penida West Tour + Manta Snorkeling from Bali, brought to you by Gorilla Adventures Bali. This unique tour combines the best of both worlds: exploring the stunning landscapes of West Nusa Penida and snorkeling with majestic manta rays. Perfect for thrill-seekers and nature lovers, this tour promises a day filled with breathtaking sights and unforgettable underwater encounters. Your journey begins with a convenient pick-up from your hotel in Bali, followed by a scenic boat ride to Nusa Penida. As you travel across the island, our knowledgeable guides will share fascinating insights into the local culture, history, and natural wonders, enriching your experience. From iconic landmarks to vibrant marine life, this tour showcases the very best of Nusa Penida. In the west, you'll visit the iconic Kelingking Beach, famous for its T-Rex-shaped cliff, and Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool with crystal-clear waters. These destinations offer stunning views and perfect photo opportunities, making them a must-visit for any traveler. After exploring these breathtaking sites, you'll head to Manta Bay for an exhilarating snorkeling adventure with manta rays. Witnessing these gentle giants in their natural habitat is an experience like no other. At Gorilla Adventures Bali, your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We ensure that all our tours are well-organized and conducted with the highest standards of safety. Join us for an unforgettable adventure on Nusa Penida and create memories that will last a lifetime

globaltix_product_data.description: Drive down to Transfagaran Road from Bucharest and explore Romania's wealth of natural landmarks and historical sites. Admire the Carpathian Mountains as you pass through Transfagarasan Road. Then, enjoy the stunning view of Balea Lake along with the peaks and valleys that surround it. Get to visit Vidraru Dam, an amazing feat of engineering that created the artificial Vidraru Lake on the Arges river where boat trips are made regularly during the summer. Finally, explore the Curtea de Arges Monastery and appreciate its striking architecture and explore its tombs where previous kings and queens are now buried. This tour is perfect for those not only looking to dig up the country's history but the see the abundance of its natural beauty as well.
highlights: - Take a road trip along Transfagarasan Road, the most spectacular road in Romania
- See Balea Lake and take in its surrounding breathtaking landscapes
- Visit the Curtea de Arges Monastery and explore the tombs of the Royal family
- Admire Vidraru Dam, a real masterpiece of modern engineering

globaltix_product_data.description: Join this all-inclusive day tour from Darwin for an incredible experience witnessing spectacular scenery and wildlife from a helicopter, airboat and wetlands cruise. Departing from Darwin, see the floodplains from the sky during a scenic helicopter flight. The adventure doesn't stop there though, because next, you will jump in an airboat for a thrilling ride through the rainforest for a close encounter with crocodiles, birds and buffalo. After working up an appetite, a gourmet BBQ meal is served on a billabong cruise and if you are feeling brave enough, you may choose to jump in the croc safe swimming cage and look one of the exciting pre-historic creatures in the eye. For a thrilling way to experience Northern Territory scenery, crocodiles and return hotel transfers - this action-packed Darwin day tour has it all!

Gourmet BBQ meal

globaltix_product_data.description: Embark on an extraordinary Abu Dhabi expedition where grandeur, spirituality, and excitement converge. Discover the awe-inspiring Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque with its intricate details and serene ambiance. Journey through Al Bateen's noble palaces before immersing yourself in art and culture at the Islamic Art gallery. Capture mesmerizing views at the Cornice, Breakwaters, and Emirates Palace during a photo stop. Experience the thrill of Ferrari World Abu Dhabi with heart-pounding rides and interactive exhibits. Reflect on the day's serenity and excitement as we return you to your Dubai hotel, leaving you with cherished memories of a remarkable adventure.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Join a day trip into the heart of Tuscany, departing from Florence and visiting San Gimignano, Siena, and Monteriggioni. Relax in a Chianti winery for a typical lunch and a guided wine tasting.
globaltix_product_data.description: Join a day trip into the heart of Tuscany, departing from Florence and visiting San Gimignano, Siena, and Monteriggioni. Relax in a Chianti winery for a typical lunch and a guided wine tasting.
highlights: Enjoy a guided tour through Siena’s historic center and Cathedral
Delight in a farm-to-table 3-course Chianti-style lunch experience
Discover the medieval charm of San Gimignano’s ancient towers
Explore Monteriggioni, a perfectly preserved walled village
Savor an authentic Chianti wine tasting at a local Tuscan winery
inclusions: Exclusive Chianti winery experience with vineyard and cellar tour

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the beautiful sights of Rottnest Island in air conditioned comfort on this combined ferry and bus tour package that will allow you to take in the historical, cultural and natural interest points of Rottnest Island all in one great value bundle. Begin the journey by departing from the mainland's Hillary's Boat Harbour at 10am as you're taken via stable and spacious ferry across the waters to Rottnest Island, and upon arrival you'll be able to board a comfortable tour bus and be taken to see all the island's many natural and historical highlights. Rottnest is not just a beautiful place - there's innumerable points of interest including cultural and architectural as well, and a bus tour ensures you make the most of your time on the island and get to see them all! View relics at the Rottnest Museum, visit Lomas Cottage and the Pilot Boat House, see the array of cute and interesting Rottnest Island wildlife; it's all here. This is the ideal Rottnest Island tour package for those short on time, so book your Rottnest ferry and bus tour online today Inclusions * Return ferry transfers from Hillarys Boat Harbour * Bayseeker Tour * Hotel transfers from major Perth CBD Hotels Exclusions * Rottnest Island Admission Fee ($20 adults & seniors, $7 children 4-12yrs), this is payable directly to the tour operator on the day of the tour Highlights * Explore the sights of Rottnest Island in air-conditioned comfort * Take in the historical, cultural and natural interest points of Rottnest Island * View the annual migration of Humpback Whales from September to November * Enjoy the array of wildlife that inhabits Rottnest * The vast natural playground has over 63 beaches and 20 bays * Rottnest Island has a large range of activities to keep the family entertained for hours * Splash and slide on the floating aqua park in Thomson Bay located just a short walking distance from the main settlement is the family fun park * Rottnest boasts an incredibly rich heritage. Take a tour up to Oliver Hill on the Captain Hussey, view relics at the Rottnest Museum, Lomas Cottage and Pilot Boat House Hotel Pickup __If you have booked a hotel__ * Prior to completing your purchase, enter your hotel name in the 'Add Booking Notes' section of the shopping cart. globaltix_product_data.summary: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. globaltix_product_data.description: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. This guided tour offers a deeply moving journey into history, providing insight into the Holocaust and the events of World War II through expert-led narration. Traveling in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle with optional hotel pickup, guests will reach the memorial site in Oświęcim, where a licensed historian guide leads a comprehensive tour of both Auschwitz I and Auschwitz II-Birkenau. Visitors will walk through original barracks, prison blocks, and memorial grounds, gaining a powerful understanding of the lives, suffering, and stories of those who were held there. The experience lasts approximately 7–10 hours and follows a fixed schedule with pre-booked entry tickets to ensure a smooth visit. Guests are picked up from their hotel or a central meeting point, transferred to the site, and guided through both camps (around 3.5 hours total), before returning to Krakow—making it a structured yet impactful day trip

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Auschwitz-Birkenau complex was established in 1940 and in operation for five years. In that time, 1.5 million people perished here. On this roundtrip from Krakow, you'll learn the facts as you tour the world's most famous concentration camp with a guide.Auschwitz is probably the most famous conc...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Auschwitz-Birkenau complex was established in 1940 and in operation for five years. In that time, 1.5 million people perished here. On this roundtrip from Krakow, you'll learn the facts as you tour the world's most famous concentration camp with a guide.Auschwitz is probably the most famous concentration camp in the world and while a trip here isn't going to top your 'fun' list, being this close to a dark chapter of history will leave you changed. Board your air-conditioned minivan in Krakow and watch a documentary en route. Once you're through the gate bearing the words – "Work sets one free" - visit the somber memorial at Auschwitz-Birkenau and meet your English-speaking guide for a tour. You'll learn the harrowing facts of the Holocaust and everyday life of the prisoners as you tour Auschwitz I - the administrative center of Auschwitz death camp, and Auschwitz II, designed and built for the gruesome purpose of extermination.You'll wander approximately 150 buildings and 300 ruins, and see original roads, fences, watchtowers, and railway ramps, all of which paint an eye-opening picture of one of the world's biggest ever genocides.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the very best of Kuala Lumpur on one of our best-selling tour packages, combining the city's iconic landmarks with its cultural and natural highlights. globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the very best of Kuala Lumpur on one of our best-selling tour packages, combining the city's iconic landmarks with its cultural and natural highlights. Perfect for first-time visitors, this tour offers a comprehensive introduction to both the vibrant city center and the scenic outskirts of Kuala Lumpur. Visit world-famous attractions such as the Petronas Twin Towers, the bustling Golden Triangle, Merdeka Square (Independence Square), and the historic Kuala Lumpur Railway Station, each showcasing a unique side of the city's rich heritage and modern development. As one of the world's most visited cities, Kuala Lumpur attracts millions of travelers each year with its blend of history, culture, shopping, and impressive architecture. The journey continues to the iconic Batu Caves, one of Malaysia's most significant Hindu shrines, renowned for its towering golden statue of Lord Murugan and colourful staircase leading to the limestone caves. Along the way, you'll also have the opportunity to visit a local Batik Factory to learn about Malaysia's traditional batik-making process. Whether you're interested in history, culture, architecture, or local experiences, this tour brings together Kuala Lumpur's must-visit attractions in a single memorable journey, leaving you with lasting memories of Malaysia's vibrant capital.

globaltix_product_data.summary: On this personalised tour of Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya, you can go wherever you wish. globaltix_product_data.description: On this personalised tour of Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya, you can go wherever you wish. Choose from a variety of amazing landmarks, natural sites, and historic icons in both cities, then listen to expert commentary. Meet your guide in the morning and discuss where you want to go. Take your pick form a long list of attractions in both Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya, or ask your guide for suggestions. After you've decided, drive out into the city and begin your day of adventure. The Batu Caves are located in Kuala Lumpur. One of the most prominent Hindu sanctuaries outside India is located within the limestone caves. Next, go see the Petronas Twin Towers, which offer panoramic views of the city from the observation deck and sky bridge that connects them. If you're interested in history, visit the National Museum to see exhibits about Malaysia's culture and rich past. The Old Railway Station and Independence Square provide additional insight into Kuala Lumpur's history. Putrajaya is home to the Taman Warisan Agricultural Heritage Park, a living museum of local plants. Spend time there discovering the native fruit trees, spices, and rubber plants of Malaysia, or visit the stunning Putra Mosque, famous for its pink dome and rose-tinted granite construction. Take a look at modern history with a stop at Perdana Putra—the prime minister's office—or enjoy scenic views of the city with a cruise on Putrajaya Lake.
highlights: Natural attractions including Batu Caves & Taman Warisan Park.
A knowledgeable guide who takes you to all of the highlights.
Landmarks like the Petronas Twin Towers & Perdana Putra.
Opportunity to learn about local history, culture & religion.
Convenience of customizing your own tour around 2 cities.

globaltix_product_data.name: Toledo and Segovia from Madrid Full Day Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: This expertly managed full-day excursion from Madrid visits two of Spain's most historically significant and visually extraordinary medieval cities — Toledo and Segovia — combining the multicultural imperial heritage of the former Castilian capital with the Roman engineering marvel and fairy-tale ca...
globaltix_product_data.description: This expertly managed full-day excursion from Madrid visits two of Spain's most historically significant and visually extraordinary medieval cities — Toledo and Segovia — combining the multicultural imperial heritage of the former Castilian capital with the Roman engineering marvel and fairy-tale castle architecture of one of Old Castile's most beloved destinations. Toledo's UNESCO World Heritage old city rises dramatically above a bend in the Tagus River in a dense and atmospheric layering of Gothic, Moorish, Jewish, and Renaissance architecture that reflects its extraordinary history as a city where Christian, Muslim, and Jewish cultures coexisted and created together during the golden centuries of the medieval period. Segovia provides the perfect complement to Toledo's medieval urban richness — its magnificent Roman aqueduct, built in the first or second century AD and still standing in remarkable completeness across the city's historic centre without a drop of mortar binding its 20,000 granite blocks, representing one of the most astonishing feats of ancient engineering surviving anywhere in Europe. The Alcázar de Segovia — its distinctive prow-shaped silhouette and fairy-tale turrets rising above the confluence of two rivers — provides the day's most romantically cinematic architectural encounter before the return journey to Madrid.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Take the ease out of making a trip to the Grampians, with this full day tour from Melbourne! Including morning tea, lunch, hotel transfers and a day filled with sight seeing, you can be sure that this Grampians Day Tour from Melbourne will be a hit! Departing at roughly 8am, you'll head out from Mel...
globaltix_product_data.description: Take the ease out of making a trip to the Grampians, with this full day tour from Melbourne! Including morning tea, lunch, hotel transfers and a day filled with sight seeing, you can be sure that this Grampians Day Tour from Melbourne will be a hit! Departing at roughly 8am, you'll head out from Melbourne for a full day adventure to one of Australia's most scenery-rich national parks, renowned for its incredible lookout points and authentic examples of Aussie bush nature. Enjoying a range of different outdoors activities, this tour will show you the very best of what the Grampians have to offer. Throughout the day you will have the opportunity to enjoy a short hike from the Wonderland Turntable to the spectacular Grand Canyon, an easy stroll to the tranquil Silverband Falls, a trip to the beautiful MacKenzie Falls, spectacular panoramic views from Reeds Lookout and finally amazing views over the Grampians mountain range from Boroka Lookout. With so many magical sights spread across the day you can be sure you'll experience a day full of wonder and adventure. If you're an animal lover, you'll be in for a real treat with guaranteed wildlife sightings possible throughout the journey! Morning tea is held at the Eureka Stockade Memorial in Ballarat, where you'll be supplied with a delicious cake, as well as coffee, tea or hot chocolate. Lunch will be in the Grampians township of Halls Gap. Tours depart at 8 am and return at around 9pm. Dinner isn't included however a stop is made on the return journey for you to purchase a meal if you wish. With a day full of adventure, be sure to wear comfortable clothing and shoes so you can make the most of this tour!
highlights: Wonderland Turntable
MacKenzies Falls

Boroka Lookout
Guaranteed wildlife sightings

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit the Great Ocean Road on this full day tour from Melbourne to witness one of the world's great drives. The dramatic, powerful and majestic Victorian coastline also known as the Ship Wreck Coast is one of Australia's most famous "must do" experiences. This full day tour on the Great Ocean Road extends from Geelong to Apollo Bay through Torquay and Lorne, featuring all the key natural and historical highlights that make this stretch of coast unique and all conducted aboard a comfortable coach with informative commentary given along the way. Enjoy the Otway National Park, to the rugged beauty of the Twelve Apostle National Park and the Twelve Apostles to Loch Ard Gorge and Port Campbell shaped by the wild Southern Ocean this coastline will not fail to impress so be sure to bring your camera! Add in extras such as complimentary hotel pickups, free on-board Wi-Fi to browse as you travel and refreshments along the way to experience the best of the Great Ocean Road in comfort and style.

globaltix_product_data.summary: A full-day trip from New York to discover Washington DC and Philadelphia with a professional bilingual guide. You will visit iconic monuments including the Iwo Jima Memorial, the Lincoln Memorial, the White House and the Capitol, with free time to have lunch and visit a Smithsonian museum. In the af...
globaltix_product_data.description: A full-day trip from New York to discover Washington DC and Philadelphia with a professional bilingual guide. You will visit iconic monuments including the Iwo Jima Memorial, the Lincoln Memorial, the White House and the Capitol, with free time to have lunch and visit a Smithsonian museum. In the afternoon you will continue to Philadelphia to explore the historic Independence National Historical Park, where you will see the Liberty Bell and Independence Hall — key sites in American history. The tour honours the famous photograph taken during the Second World War: the raising of the US flag at the Battle of Iwo Jima, Japan. You will continue to the imposing Lincoln Memorial, dedicated to the president who championed the abolition of slavery in the United States. Washington DC is the seat of the three branches of the US government. During the tour you will stop to admire two of them from the outside: the White House, residence and office of the US President, and the Capitol, home of Congress where the country's laws are made. Your Washington visit will conclude with free time for lunch and a possible brief visit to one of the Smithsonian museums, such as the famous National Air and Space Museum. Your next destination will be the first capital of the United States, chosen during the War of Independence.

globaltix_product_data.summary: One of the most popular tourist sites in the Czech Republic, this six hour round-trip guided tour takes you through lush Bohemian countryside, and to the once-mighty town of Kutná Hora. globaltix_product_data.description: One of the most popular tourist sites in the Czech Republic, this six hour round-trip guided tour takes you through lush Bohemian countryside, and to the once-mighty town of Kutná Hora. The gruesome highlight is undoubtedly the chapel at Kutná Hora, which is made of human bones. Yup, a chapel. Made of human bones.The Old Town of Kutná Hora is a gorgeous UNESCO World Heritage site. At one point Kutná Hora's riches rivaled Prague's thanks to its silver mines. This guided tour will give you a better understanding of the history of Bohemia, and will also show you the most artfully arranged human bones you'll ever see.Located beneath the Cemetery Church of All Saints, the Sedlec Ossuary is a chilling display of the skeletal fragments of 40,000-70,000 people. Let your tour guide explain how it came to be. All Saints was a 13th century church that ran out of grave space but it wasn’t until 1870 that František Rint got creative with its contents. Here stands a chandelier made of every bone of the human body, over there, a column of skulls, and over there a coat of arms made of - what else? - arms. Afterwards you'll board the bus back to Prague, in touch with the lush countryside, and the all-too fleeting nature of our own existence. Make sure to treat yourself to the rest of your when you make it back to Prague. Life's too short for naps.
highlights: Take a day trip to UNESCO’s cultural heritage town Kutná Hora by bus from Prague with a guide
Enter the Gothic St. Barbara’s Church and admire its medieval frescoes and flying buttresses
Visit the Ossuary and see its eerie decoration made of over 40,000 human bones dating back to 1511

Book this Milford Sound day tour from Queenstown to enjoy return transfers and a 1 hr 45 min nature cruise to see cascading waterfalls, abundant marine life and rainforest clad cliffs collide. Escape the crowns with Altitude Tours small group travel. The iconic Milford Sound is likely among the first images that pops into your head when you think of New Zealand and this Milford Sound day tour will whisk you away from Queenstown to experience the incredible spectacle all in one day. Return transfers back to Queenstown will deliver you back to your hotel just in time for dinner.

globaltix_product_data.description: A Lake Wakatipu cruise on the TSS Earnslaw is akin to stepping back in time - the steam-driven vessel dubbed "The Lady of the Lake" provides the venue for a one and a half hour cruise that showcases some of the best of New Zealand's alpine scenery. You'll have ample time to explore the decks and bridge of this historical cruise ship, visit the engine room and view the historical collection of photos in its gallery. With such facilities on board as a licensed cafe and bar that serves both a selection of cafe-style food, beer, wine and spirits, you'll have access to everything you need to enjoy the cruise on these scenic waters in comfort while soaking in the natural majesty that surrounds you in every direction. The cruises depart regularly throughout the day and are suitable for all ages.
highlights: Take a tour of the engine room

90 minute cruise across Lake Wakatipu
Family friendly cruise
Spectacular Queenstown alpine scenery

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore how the ancient civilization of Rome filled their lives with leisure and luxury. This Tomb was constructed during the Reign of Emperor Augustus in honor of Caecilia Metella, the daughter of a Roman Consul. The mausoleum is shaped in a circular way similar to that of Augustus only smaller. The Tomb is one of the most well-known and well-preserved mausoleums along the Via Appia. Although the tomb itself is more or less in ruins it is still an inspiring sight to see. The construction is quite beautiful and is worth a visit. This sumptuous villa was the largest and most luxurious residence in ancient Rome and belonged to the Quintilii brothers. However, the brothers couldn't enjoy the villa for long as Emperor Commodus had set his eyes on the building and had the brothers killed and took the villa for himself. The monumental complex stands over the Roman countryside and offers a panorama that through time has inspired many famous artists. One of the highlights of the villa is the well-preserved baths complex with a pool, caldarium (hot room) and frigidarium (cold room). Now you can also visit the small museum, which shows the history of the sumptuous villa.
highlights: Romans made cool circular tombs and big villas like the one owned by the Quintilii brothers, showing they liked fancy stuff.
Romans loved relaxing and having fun. The Quintilii villa had neat baths with pools and hot and cold rooms for chilling out.
Even now, Roman luxury is interesting. These old places remind us how rich people lived back then, and they’re fun to visit and learn about.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. This guided tour offers a deeply mov...
globaltix_product_data.description: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. This guided tour offers a deeply moving journey into history, providing insight into the Holocaust and the events of World War II through expert-led narration. Traveling in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle with optional hotel pickup, guests will reach the memorial site in Oświęcim, where a licensed historian guide leads a comprehensive tour of both Auschwitz I and Auschwitz II-Birkenau. Visitors will walk through original barracks, prison blocks, and memorial grounds, gaining a powerful understanding of the lives, suffering, and stories of those who were held there. The experience lasts approximately 7–10 hours and follows a fixed schedule with pre-booked entry tickets to ensure a smooth visit. Guests are picked up from their hotel or a central meeting point, transferred to the site, and guided through both camps (around 3.5 hours total), before returning to Krakow—making it a structured yet impactful day trip
highlights: Experience one of the world’s most important UNESCO heritage sites with deep historical insights from licensed educators.
Visit Auschwitz I and Birkenau with a professional guide while exploring original barracks, memorial sites, and historical exhibits.
Ideal for history enthusiasts, educators, and travelers seeking a meaningful and educational experience.
Includes skip-the-line entry (selected options), guided tour, round-trip transport, and optional hotel pickup in Krakow.

globaltix_product_data.description: Frost Magical Ice of Siam Pattaya is an icy amusement park that lets you feel the chill of the Arctic without actually going there. It’s an ice sculpture display in a non-temperate region as the amusement park is kept at a chilly -10 degrees Celsius in the Ice Dome, making it an ideal vacation spot for those looking to escape the sweltering summer months. This is the first ever Ice Dome located in Pattaya with beautiful ice statuettes, exhibits, and fun activities in extreme chilly surroundings. With the three magnificent zones, i.e., the Siam Heaven, the Himmapan Zone, and the Frost Village & Food zone, the Frost Magical Ice of Siam Pattaya becomes Thailand’s perfect vacation spot to escape the boring summer day. From walking around the dome buildings, ice caves, Igloos, and other icy sculptures to sipping a soda served in the glasses made of ice, there are various relaxing activities that can be done here. Since the whole surface of the Ice Dome is made of ice, the visitors are advised to exercise caution while walking as it can get extremely slippery.
highlights: Frost Magical Ice of Siam features a stunning exhibition of intricate ice sculptures created by talented artists.
The attraction offers a unique ice bar experience where guests can enjoy drinks served in glasses made entirely of ice.
Guests can have fun in the ice play area, which may include ice slides, ice sculptures for climbing, and interactive installations.
Frost Magical Ice of Siam may feature themed zones that showcase different aspects of ice and winter.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Fukui Prefectural Dinosaur Museum is located in Katsuyama City, Fukui Prefecture. It is a geological and paleontological museum with a primary focus on dinosaur fossils and serves as a major excavation site for dinosaur fossils.Inside the museum, housed within a gleaming silver dome, the exhibition areas are divided into three sections: "Dinosaur World," "Earth Science," and "Life History."In the expansive 4,500-square-meter exhibition hall, visitors can explore over 50 dinosaur skeletons, hundreds of specimens, large-scale reconstruction scenes, and multimedia displays.The museum is designed to provide an enjoyable learning experience for children and adults alike, catering to both educational and research needs by supporting academic endeavors with its exhibits.
highlights: Discover geological formations, minerals, and the science behind Earth’s history.
Learn about the evolution of life on Earth through captivating displays of fossils and ancient life forms.
Explore over 50 full-scale dinosaur skeletons, including popular species like the Tyrannosaurus Rex and Triceratops.
The museum caters to visitors of all ages with engaging exhibits suitable for kids and adults alike.
Multimedia displays, interactive models, and large-scale reconstructions bring the prehistoric era to life.
inclusions: Fukui Prefectural Dinosaur Museum Admission Ticket

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Malta experiences heavy traffic, especially in peak season. Parking near the departure point is limited. Please allow extra time, we cannot be held responsible for late arrivals. The FULL DAY TOURS departs promptly at 10:00 AM. Boarding opens at 8:30am and closes at 9:45am. The SUNSET HALF DAY TOUR departs at 17:15. Boarding at 16:50 and departure at 17:15 sharp. No refunds will be issued for late arrivals or missed departures. globaltix_product_data.name: Tasman Island Cruise Day Tour from Hobart
globaltix_product_data.summary: Head out on an epic journey to visit one of Australia's most unique and unusual islands - the flat and rugged Tasman Island - on an amazing full day tour including an unforgettable three hour Tasman Island cruise. The full day tour will take you from Hobart aboard a bus to then join your wilderness...
globaltix_product_data.description: Head out on an epic journey to visit one of Australia's most unique and unusual islands - the flat and rugged Tasman Island - on an amazing full day tour including an unforgettable three hour Tasman Island cruise. The full day tour will take you from Hobart aboard a bus to then join your wilderness guides and board a purpose-built high-speed boat engineered for maximum stability. You will embark on a trip to view the home of the highest sea cliffs in the Southern Hemisphere. Known for its array of sea caves and towering rock formations, Tasman Island is home to a range of impressive wildlife and on this tour you'll be able to get up close with hundreds of seals, spot dolphins in the waters, and witness thousands of seabirds ranging from falcons to the massive albatross swooping through the skies. The huge, flat island is one of the most remarkable sights in the ocean, and your experienced guides will provide interesting and entertaining commentary on the geography and history of how Tasman Island was used both past and present. This is set to be a day filled with beautiful sights and informative commentary about the region. There are few places on Earth that blend animal life with incredible cliffs and geological wonders quite like Tasman Island, and you'll have everything you need during this adventure to witness all its wonders firsthand. Visit a place in Australia you've likely never been but definitely should - book a Tasman Island tour online today. This experience takes you on the 3Hour cruise, Port Arthur Lavender Farm, Chocolate Store and Remarkable Caves
highlights: Travel along the spectacular coastline of the Tasman National Park
Few places on Earth have such a rich variety of marine wildlife and seabirds
The cruise takes you underneath the highest sea cliffs in the southern hemisphere
Open-air tiered seating gives each passenger an excellent all-round view
Full day tour from Hobart and Delicious morning tea and lunch served at local restaurants on the Tasman Peninsula

options.description: Tasman Island Cruises provides unforgettable three hour wilderness cruises along the spectacular coastline between Port Arthur and Eaglehawk Neck in southern Tasmania. The cruise travels beneath the highest vertical sea cliffs in the Southern Hemisphere at Cape Pillar. Guests explore waterfalls, rock formations, archways and deep-sea caves. The coastline is part of the Tasman National Park. It is home to a variety of wildlife including hundreds of seals, migrating whales and abundant sea birds in their thousands. At any time of year you're likely to see the feeding frenzy of diving gannets, albatross and sea eagles wheeling on the wind, cliff-nesting cormorants and peregrine falcons, or a pod of playful dolphins surfing the bow wave of the boat. globaltix_product_data.description: Gardens by the Bay is a must-visit destination in Singapore — now proudly recognised as Tripadvisor's No. 3 Top Attraction in the World. From iconic Supertrees to breathtaking conservatories, discover the place where wonder blooms. Don’t miss the attraction the world is talking about. Visit one of Singapore’s top attractions—Gardens by the Bay! Get your ticket today and enjoy a series of gardens full of flora and fauna set in mesmerizing interior and exterior structures. With the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest ticket, access the Flower Dome, the world's largest greenhouse, to witness its collection of exquisite florals and lush plants. Tour different gardens such as Mediterranean Garden, Succulent Garden, Australian Garden and more. Then, head to Cloud Forest, which boasts one of the world's largest indoor waterfalls at 35 metres tall. This landscape offers dramatic greenery, featuring vegetation that is typically native to habitats 2,000 metres above sea level. You can also admire the breathtaking Flight of the Moth Orchid display, a striking selection of orchids that form a cascading bloom. globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the beautiful Garuda Wisnu Kencana (GWK) Cultural Park, home to the stunning GWK statue! Roam the massive park and marvel at the beauty of one of Bali's most popular cultural icons. Here, you can witness the statue of God Vishnu riding a mythical bird Garuda, a masterpiece that took 28 years of journey to its completion. The idea came into the great artist I Nyoman Nuarta's mind in 1989, realized in 1997 and finally finished in 2018. Along with the artist's team, they finally placed the last modules of the statue out of 754 modules! Now, you can see the 121-meter statue standing tall surrounded by a beautiful scenery with just a ticket. Choose to explore the park by foot or with a Segway, and don't forget to catch the amazing Kecak dance at sundown!
highlights: Learn about the incredible 28-year journey from conception to completion, led by the visionary artist I Nyoman Nuarta.
Marvel at the colossal statue of God Vishnu riding the mythical bird Garuda, a representation of power, strength, and wisdom.
Opt for a Segway tour of the park for a fun and eco-friendly way to explore its vast grounds.
Purchase your entrance ticket to the park and enjoy access to the statue, park grounds, and cultural performances.
The park is open daily from [insert operating hours], allowing ample time for exploration and enjoyment.

Guests are encouraged to bring a hat, umbrella, or sun and rain protection for comfort.

Roam the massive park and marvel at the beauty of one of Bali's most popular cultural icons. Here, you can witness the statue of God Vishnu riding a mythical bird Garuda, a masterpiece that took 28 years of journey to its completion. The idea came into the great artist I Nyoman Nuarta's mind in 1989, realized in 1997 and finally finished in 2018. Along with the artist's team, they finally placed the last modules of the statue out of 754 modules! Choose to explore the park by foot or with a Segway, and don't forget to catch the amazing Kecak dance at sundown!

globaltix_product_data.summary: Head to the Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park in First World Plaza for an exciting, all-day adventure! Test your limits and make sure to hop on one of...
globaltix_product_data.description: Head to the Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park in First World Plaza for an exciting, all-day adventure! Embrace the thrills and frills of the park, surrounded by beautiful Genting Highlands. Start your adventure by exploring the expansive indoor theme park. Test your limits and make sure to hop on one of their many exhilarating rides. Spin around on their colorful Royal Carousel or take a heart-stopping plunge on the Sky Towers at gravity-defying speeds. The possibilities are endless! Rides Introduction: Family Rides: Boo Boo Bump - A fun miniature bumper car ride where children can gently bump their way around. Parental supervision is required at all times. Riders must be between 105cm and 140cm in height. Ride ‘Em Round - A classic merry-go-round with seats that move up and down, perfect for children. Parental supervision is required at all times. Riders must be between 90cm and 122cm in height. Copper Express - A family-friendly open-top train ride with mild curves. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Tea Cups - An oversized spinning tea cup ride offering multiple twirling motions for the whole family. Riders under 105cm in height are not permitted. Children between 105cm and 130cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Chariot Cruise - A family-friendly flying cruise that loops around the park. Riders under 110cm or over 195cm in height are not permitted. Children between 110cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Adventure Rides: Loop de Loop - A miniature track ride with gentle curves and slopes, designed for children. Parental supervision is required at all times. Riders must be between 90cm and 122cm in height. Balloon Race - A family-friendly balloon ride featuring fast spins and twirls. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Royal Carousel - A grand, double-story carousel adorned with intricately carved horses and chariots. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Space Cadets - A family-friendly ride with controllable flying motions, allowing guests to pilot their own adventure. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Soaring Ships - A suspended ride that offers breathtaking aerial views of the park, perfect for the whole family. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Sky Towers - An exhilarating drop tower ride that plunges at gravity-defying speeds. Riders under 105cm in height are not permitted. Children between 105cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Skyscraper - A towering Ferris wheel with colorful gondolas, offering a magnificent panoramic view of the park. Riders under 90cm in height are not permitted. Children between 90cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Thrill Rides: Disco! - A gigantic spinning disc that swings back and forth while rotating rapidly, gaining speed as it travels. Riders under 122cm in height are not permitted. Spin Crazy - An extreme spinning pendulum that soars through the air with thrilling 360-degree rotations. Riders under 130cm or over 195cm in height are not permitted. Super Glider - A suspended lie-down coaster featuring sharp turns, sudden drops, and high-speed curves—perfect for thrill-seekers. Riders under 135cm in height are not permitted. Power Surge - A high-intensity ride with wild spinning motions and upside-down thrills. Riders under 122cm in height are not permitted. Music Express - A fast-spinning ride with sudden slopes, twirling motion, and a thrilling backward surge. Riders under 130cm in height are not permitted. Children between 130cm and 140cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Bumper Boss - A dynamic bumper car arena where guests can unleash their inner racer. Riders under 120cm in height are not permitted. Children between 120cm and 130cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. The Bolt - A family-friendly rollercoaster that takes riders to the highest peak of Skytropolis, offering a bird’s-eye view of the park while navigating through gentle dips and turns. Guests under 130cm and above 190cm in height may not ride.
highlights: Rides and Attractions: The park spans over 400,000 sq ft and offers more than 20 rides for the whole family.
Embrace the thrills and frills of the park, surrounded by beautiful Genting Highlands.
Family Rides: Enjoy family rides with family such as Boo Boo Bump, Ride ‘Em Round, Copper Express, Tea Cups, and Chariot Cruise.
Adventure Rides: Enjoy adventure rides such as Loop de Loop, Balloon Race, Royal Carousel, Space Cadets, Bumper Boss, Music Express, Power Surge etcs.
Thrill Rides: Enjoy thrill rides such a Disco!, Spin Crazy and Super Glider.
inclusions: Pay Per Ride: Thrill (ticket permits a one-time experience on one ride.)
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission The ticket is valid for 1 month from the date of purchase. Malaysian rates are valid for Malaysian Citizens only. globaltix_product_data.summary: Enjoy a fun day at Genting SkyWorlds theme park with this day pass! Explore all 9 uniquely-themed worlds and make sure to hop on the 26 rides and attractions. Bring the whole family for a full day of fun and adventure!
globaltix_product_data.description: Enjoy a fun day at Genting SkyWorlds theme park with this day pass! Explore all 9 uniquely-themed worlds and make sure to hop on the 26 rides and attractions. Bring the whole family for a full day of fun and adventure!
highlights: Explore all 9 uniquely-themed worlds and make sure to hop on the 26 rides and attractions.
Rides and Attractions: The major rides you should prioritize are Planet of the Apes, Independence Day, Acorn Adventure, and the Epic water ride.
Robots Rivet Town: Assemble for non-stop family fun in the vibrant world of Robots!
Ice Age: A pre-historic adventure with attractions inspired by the globally recognized franchise, Ice Age.
Central Park: Gather in the buzzing town square to experience the best of world-class attractions, dining, retail and live entertainment.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Ticket valid on selected date only. Malaysian rates valid for Malaysian Citizens only (physical MyKad required for verification). Non-Malaysian rates apply to international travelers. Eligibility Guests must purchase the correct ticket type. Child ticket is based on height, not age (Child above 110cm must purchase Adult ticket). Adult: Above 110cm height. Child: 90cm – 110cm height. Free admission: Children below 90cm height. Senior: Aged 60 and above. Wrong ticket purchases require top-up to Walk-In rate. Customers must contact the original purchase channel for ticket issues. Rainy Day Guarantee applies only to eligible ticket types and valid purchase channels. Attraction Access Subject to rides and attractions availability on the day of visit. Some rides, attractions, entertainment, or outlets may be unavailable, modified, or operating at reduced capacity. Rainy Day Guarantee free return applies only if it rains continuously for one hour during park operating hours. Additional Information Tickets are non-transferable, non-refundable, and not for resale. No validity date changes allowed after purchase. Guests must keep confirmation email and original ticket for verification. Free return visit requires original ticket and mobile app push notification. For more information on the Free return visit, please refer more information from the link: https://www.gentingskyworlds.com/en/tickets/rainy-day-guarantee.html No cash alternative for Rainy Day Guarantee. Malaysian law applies to all Terms & Conditions. English version prevails if translation conflicts occur. Important Notes Rainy Day Guarantee can only be used once per original ticket transaction. Weather determination is recorded by Genting SkyWorlds and is final. Not valid with other promotions. If it rains again during return visit, no additional free visit will be given. Excludes add-ons such as parking, Skyway, Photo+, VQ, etc. Certain ticket types (complimentary, annual pass, multi-day, combo, corporate packages) are excluded.

globaltix_product_data.description: “Dive straight into an unforgettable experience at the Georgia Aquarium — the largest aquarium in the Western Hemisphere. Explore a stunning array of marine life across seven immersive galleries, all designed to inspire, educate, and entertain. Enjoy convenient onsite parking and refuel at the Coastline Café during your visit. Get up close with a whale shark, manta rays, and sharks in Ocean Voyager built by The Home DepotOne of the world's largest aquatic exhibits. Walk through the breathtaking underwater tunnel or view the massive habitat from a floor-to-ceiling window. Witness the agility and intelligence of bottlenose dolphins in a high-energy presentation led by expert trainers. Then, journey to icy waters to meet remarkable creatures like beluga whales and the Giant Pacific Octopus. Marvel at the intricate beauty of weedy seadragons, explore the colorful world of tropical fish, and come face-to-face with playful California sea lions. Don't miss the awe-inspiring living coral reef exhibit — one of the most expansive of its kind.

Explore vibrant coral reefs, tropical fish habitats, and fascinating creatures like seadragons and octopuses.

globaltix_product_data.description: Exploring Chicago is easy with Go City. Choose your duration and enjoy 1, 2, 3 or 5-days access to over 35 top attractions, activities and museums, all on one digital pass. Use the Go City app to choose what you want to do and when - then simply scan your pass for entry. Hop-on a tour around town with Big Bus Chicago, check out the amazing views from 360 Chicago, explore the Field Museum, have fun on the rides at Navy Pier, then enjoy a scenic river cruise - there's all this and more!What's included on the Chicago Pass?• Skydeck Chicago • Seadog Architectural River Tour from Navy Pier • 360 CHICAGO • Shedd Aquarium • Hop-On Hop-Off Big Bus Chicago: 1-Day Discover Tour • Shoreline Architecture River Cruise • Field Museum • Griffin Museum of Science and Industry • Navy Pier Ferris Wheel and Rides • Adler Planetarium • Museum of Illusions Chicago • Flyover Chicago • Seadog Lakefront Speedboat Tour • Chicago Children's Museum • Museum of Contemporary Art • and more! Buckle up and enjoy the rides at Ferrari World, whizz to the top of the Burj Khalifa, then head out into the desert for quad-biking or a BBQ dinner with belly dancing - these are just some of the 50+ tours and attractions included on the pass. globaltix_product_data.description: Aquaduck Gold Coast was established in 1996, the now famous & iconic Aquaduck remains Australia's first and finest amphibious adventure. Departing from Surfers Paradise, these tours offer a perfect blend of city tours and river cruising. We cruise past the fancy waterfront mansions of the rich and famous while taking in the spectacular views of the Gold Coast waterways and famous landmarks.
highlights: Learn from an expert guide about iconic landmarks, riverside villas, and local wildlife along the journey.
Kids can steer the Aquaduck with the captain’s help and receive a personalized helmsman certificate.
Enjoy scenic views of Gold Coast waterways and luxurious waterfront mansions of the rich and famous.
Seamlessly transition from road to water as the vehicle transforms into a cruise at a dedicated launch point.
Experience Australia’s original amphibious adventure, combining a city tour and river cruise from Surfers Paradise.
inclusions: 3. The guide provides commentary along the way, with engaging English narration on board; the boat also offers an audio guide in Chinese (6 language options: Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, and Korean).

Infinity is one of the Gold Coasts favourite attractions, comprised of an extraordinary series of around 20 multi-sensual environments. Be transported into another world filled...
globaltix_product_data.description: Infinity Attraction on the Gold Coast is a mind blowing journey into a spectacular, futuristic, maze-like world of wonder. Infinity is one of the Gold Coasts favourite attractions, comprised of an extraordinary series of around 20 multi-sensual environments. Be transported into another world filled with unique special effects, atmospheric sound fields, ultra groovy music and illusions that appear to go all the way to – Infinity. This unique Infinity journey is a fantastic out-of-this-world experience and is great for both kids and adults. Infinity Gold Coast is suitable for all ages from 8-108 offering unforgettable family fun right in the heart of Surfers Paradise. It is also a great idea if you are looking for something fun to do on a rainy day on the Gold Coast or even to escape the heat of summer. For an awesome sensory overload visit Infinity the special effects fun house like nothing else you have ever experienced.
highlights: Unique special effects, Futuristic maze
Atmospheric sound fields
10% off digital photo package
20 multi-sensual environments
Ultra groovy music and illusions
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Ticket valid 30 days from date of purchased. If special effects lighting, sound, dark confined spaces or illusions of height and depth cause you concern, please make further enquiries before purchasing admission. Alternatively please see all entry and safety conditions here If uneven and unstable floors in some areas might affect you, please make further enquiries before entry You must not enter INFINITY if you have consumed alcohol or drugs INFINITY is not recommended for children under 8 years or for anyone with an unusual fear of darkness Children under the age of 12 years must be accompanied by an adult/carer who accepts responsibility for their care, safety and conduct Child (4-13yrs) Prams and children in backpacks cannot be admitted. Babies carried in forward carrying slings will only be admitted at parent’s risk. We don't recommend entering with a baby or toddler. Children must be able to walk through unassisted Parents with young children who feel threatened by the dark or unknown: Does your child have an unusual fear of the dark? In some of Infinity’s environments, the special effects require a very low level of light. A small percentage of young children and some adults may feel anxious under these conditions. INFINITY is a series of fun environments. Although there is nothing in INFINITY that is designed to frighten (e.g. nothing jumps out or grabs you) some people may feel dismayed due to the ‘unknown’. In the Mystery Zone (only one of 20 zones) patrons use their sense of touch to feel their way under very low light effects. If you think that you or your child might be adversely affected you should refrain from entering or purchase a glow stick on entry. Please make sure you watch and explain the safety instruction in the video you will before entry. Ask for more information if you have any doubts.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Enjoy wine tastings, lunch and sightseeing in the Central Otago region with this 7-hour Gourmet Wine Tour. Aboard an air-conditioned vehicle, you'll travel through three contrasting wine sub-regions; Gibbston, Cromwell and the Bannockburn basin, each with their own unique soil, terroir and climate....
globaltix_product_data.description: Enjoy wine tastings, lunch and sightseeing in the Central Otago region with this 7-hour Gourmet Wine Tour. Aboard an air-conditioned vehicle, you'll travel through three contrasting wine sub-regions; Gibbston, Cromwell and the Bannockburn basin, each with their own unique soil, terroir and climate. The 7-hour tour includes wine tastings at all of the vineyards, including Australasia's largest underground wine cave and tastings at three premium vineyards. Indulge in Stoaker’s gourmet lunch which consists of five dishes cooked in retired French Oak Pinot Noir wine barrels and perfectly matched with five wines. The ultimate wine and food adventure, wine-lovers and foodies won't be disappointed with the selection of wines available throughout the tour. Guests are also given the opportunity to purchase additional glass or bottles of wine from the vineyards to take home or enjoy on the tour. Learn about the early pioneering history and how the wine region was formed through an array of fun facts and interesting stories from your knowledgeable wine guide. For your final indulgence of the day, you will be given some artisan chocolates before being returned to your accommodation. The Gourmet Food & Wine Tour is wonderful and memorable day out that combines delicious food, exquisite wines and jaw-dropping, non-stop scenery. Tour departs from central Queenstown with pick ups at around 9.30am and returns at 4.30pm * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * For your information, full details of the Tour Operator including contact phone number will be printed on your tour voucher * Mobile Vouchers are accepted! - Vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device for this attraction. globaltix_product_data.description: Join the fun and get to know Granada’s most fascinating sights aboard the city train. Create your own itinerary, hop off and back again at your leisure and discover one of the most beautiful cities in Spain. Hop On the Alhambra Route during the day to visit the most important places in the city. Get close to the impressive monument of the Alhambra, enjoy the views from the Mirador de San Cristóbal or marvel at the Cathedral of Granada, among others. Choose between the two ticket options offered and take a one-way single trip or enjoy the experience to hop on and off as many times as you wish at any of our stops. globaltix_product_data.description: Grand World Phu Quoc is a large entertainment complex located on the island of Phu Quoc in Vietnam. The complex includes a variety of attractions and activities, making it a popular destination for families and tourists. The main attraction of Grand World Phu Quoc is its theme park, which features a range of rides and attractions for visitors of all ages. The park includes a Ferris wheel, roller coasters, water slides, and other thrill rides, as well as family-friendly attractions such as carousels and playgrounds. In addition to the theme park, Grand World Phu Quoc also features a casino, offering a range of games and entertainment options for adults. The casino includes slot machines, table games, and a VIP gaming area. The complex also includes a shopping mall, featuring a range of retail stores selling clothes, accessories, souvenirs, and other items. There are also a variety of dining options available, including restaurants, cafes, and snack bars. Overall, Grand World Phu Quoc is a fun and exciting destination for anyone looking for a day or night out on Phu Quoc Island. With its range of attractions, activities, and entertainment options, it's a great place to spend a full day or even multiple days exploring all that it has to offer.
