globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Timing and other notes 1. The timing for Guangzhou BONSKI starts when entering the gate by swiping the card and ends when exiting the gate. No refund or compensation will be given for unused time within the ticket duration. Any time exceeding the ticket duration is considered overtime, and guests shall pay the difference according to the prices displayed at the ticket office. (Overtime fee reference: Off-peak season: CNY 40/30 min; Regular season: CNY 50/30 min; Peak season: CNY 60/30 min. No additional fee is charged for overtime within 30 min. For overtime exceeding 30 min, the fee is charged per half-hour, with any duration less than half an hour rounded up.) Guangzhou BONSKI date definition: Off-peak season: Dates excluding shoulder season and peak season. Off-peak season: Saturdays and Sundays; the first 10 days (inclusive) and last 7 days (inclusive) of Lunar New Year holiday; Mondays to Fridays from July to August; Christmas week from December 19th to 27th. Peak season: Public holidays; Saturdays and Sundays in July and August. 2. Opening hours: Check the opening hours of Guangzhou BONSKI on the "BONSKI" mini program, subject to on-site announcements. 3. Deposit not required at Guangzhou BONSKI. Ski clothes, ski shoes, helmets, ski boards, ski poles (for double boards only), lockers with bracelets, and Snow Cards will be provided for free. If any of these items are damaged or lost, compensations must be made based on the prices announced on-site. 4. After entering the ski resort, please keep your ski pass with you at all times. The ski pass is required for equipment collection and return, and it will be reclaimed upon exiting the resort. Safety and security notice Skiing is a high-risk activity. If you have heart disease, high blood pressure, acrophobia, cardiovascular or cerebrovascular diseases, epilepsy, asthma, or any other condition that makes strenuous exercise inadvisable as advised by a doctor, or if you are pregnant, under the influence of alcohol, or affected by medication, please carefully consider your physical condition before participating. 2. Minors should be accompanied by adults when skiing, and it is not recommended for elderly individuals to participate in skiing. 3. The resort features ski slopes of varying difficulty levels, including beginner, intermediate, and advanced slopes. Beginners attempting intermediate or advanced slopes are at higher risk of sports injuries. Additionally, the resort includes kickers, jump platforms, rails, and terrain park areas, which require advanced skiing skills. Please choose activities according to your skill level and ensure you stay within your capabilities for a safe skiing experience. 4. Please wear a ski helmet at all times. It is recommended to bring and wear safety gear such as gloves, goggles, face masks, wrist guards, elbow pads, back protectors, knee pads, and hip protectors to minimize the risk of injury. 5. Please select ski equipment appropriate for your skill level. Before skiing, thoroughly inspect the rented gear to ensure it's in good condition. Verify that the ski binding release pressure matches your height, weight, and boot size, the binding release torque is properly set for skis, and the binding angle and stance width are correctly adjusted for snowboards. If any adjustments are needed, immediately inform the staff and request modifications or replacements. 6. It is recommended for beginners to hire a ski instructor for guidance before hitting the slopes. Ski lessons are available on-site, please purchase as needed. 7. To avoid unnecessary disputes, please refrain from the following actions: (1) Engaging in activities beyond the scope of product benefits (including areas, items, etc.), conducting unauthorized ski lessons, commercial filming, live streaming, personal solicitation, obtaining or purchasing goods/services for resale purposes, or any other improper use without prior reporting or ski resort approval. (2) Allowing others to use your product benefits through transfer, resale, lending, or similar means; (3) Engaging in any dangerous, illegal, or offensive behavior; (4) Engaging in behavior that severely disrupts normal operations of the ski resort or significantly endangers others' personal or property safety. (5) Other inappropriate conduct. In the event of the above circumstances, the ski resort reserves the right to take any or all of the following measures at any time without bearing liability for compensation or breach of contract: (1) Add you to the visitor blacklist, including the Guangzhou BONSKI blacklist (you will be unable to enter Guangzhou BONSKI), the BONSKI brand blacklist (you will be unable to enter any BONSKI ski resorts and other cooperative ski resorts), and the industry alliance blacklist. (2) Revoke, invalidate, or freeze your products and benefits without extending the unused remaining period/refunding any fees. (3) A penalty fee of 30% of the booking amount will be charged. If the penalty is insufficient to cover the losses, additional compensation will be pursued. 8. Smoking is prohibited in the ski area (including tobacco products, e-cigarettes, or any other products that produce smoke). To maintain a pleasant environment, please refrain from smoking in the ski area. Violators will be added to the visitors' blocklist and banned from entering the park for 15 days. 9. If any abnormalities or malfunctions occur during the operation of the facilities and equipment in the ski resort, they must be shut down for inspection. Some facilities may be suspended or closed without prior notice. In such cases, admission ticket extensions or cancellations will not be offered. 10. Due to capacity, severe weather, special events, safety, or order reasons, the ski resort's operating hours or the availability of activities may be adjusted. Please refer to the actual announcements at the ski resort on the day of your visit. 11. Please cooperate with the security check before entry. Do not carry flammable, explosive, or hazardous items, state-controlled instruments, or any items that pose safety risks. Personal selling activities by visitors are prohibited in the ski area, and excessive items are not allowed. Outside food, beverages, drinking water, etc. (excluding baby food) may cause food safety issues, so please consume them before entering. 12. If you experience any discomfort or emergencies during your visit, please seek immediate assistance from on-site staff. 13. It is recommended to purchase sports accident insurance that includes skiing in advance. Please carefully read and comply with all safety notices, venue rules, equipment usage instructions, this "Ski Resort Notice," and other safety guidelines, including but not limited to "Entry Instructions," "Security Check Instructions," "Skiers' Instructions," "Skiers' Code of Conduct," and "Skiers' Safety Rules." Please pay attention to all warning and reminder signs in the venue and follow the relevant regulations. Entry implies acceptance of the above terms. globaltix_product_data.description: Embark on a captivating journey that combines natural wonders with ancient history on the Salda Lake and Pamukkale Full-Day Guided Tour from Antalya.  This adventure takes you to two of Turkey's most stunning locations, offering a perfect blend of relaxation and exploration.  Start your day by discovering the beauty of Salda Lake, often referred to as the ""Turkish Maldives"" for its remarkable resemblance to the famous island chain.  Relax on the pristine white sand beaches, take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear turquoise waters, and marvel at the lake's mesmerizing beauty.  Soak up the sun and capture stunning photographs in this idyllic natural paradise.

globaltix_product_data.name: Guided Tour of the Seville Cathedral
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Cathedral of Seville is the largest Gothic cathedral in the world and one of the most architecturally magnificent and historically significant religious buildings in the whole of Spain — a UNESCO World Heritage monument of staggering scale, extraordinary artistic richness, and profound historica...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Cathedral of Seville is the largest Gothic cathedral in the world and one of the most architecturally magnificent and historically significant religious buildings in the whole of Spain — a UNESCO World Heritage monument of staggering scale, extraordinary artistic richness, and profound historical resonance that stands as the supreme achievement of Andalusian Christian civilisation on the site of the city's former great Almohad mosque. The Amigo Tours guided experience provides expert navigational and historical context through the cathedral's most significant and rewarding spaces — transforming what can be an overwhelming encounter with one of the world's largest religious buildings into a carefully curated and deeply engaging cultural journey. The guide leads guests through the cathedral's most celebrated treasures — the monumental tomb of Christopher Columbus carried by four royal pallbearers in sculpted bronze, the extraordinary main altarpiece of gilded carved wood that is the largest in the world, the Giralda tower with its distinctive Moorish minaret base and Renaissance upper section providing panoramic views across Seville from its summit, and the magnificent chapter house and sacristy containing works by Murillo, Zurbarán, and Goya from the cathedral's extraordinary art collection.

globaltix_product_data.description: Westminster Abbey situated on the north bank of the River Thames in London, next to the Houses of Parliament, is a magnificent Royal Catholic Cathedral in the Gothic style, a holy place in England, and prominent among the many churches in the country. The coronation throne of Edward I is located behind the church altar. This dilapidated seat has witnessed the changes of the British royal family for hundreds of years.
highlights: Explore the magnificent, solemn, and quiet representative of Gothic architecture, and experience the thousand-year history of the majestic church
Stroll through the British State Burial Mausoleum and visit the resting places of royal family members and legendary figures such as Newton, Darwin, and Churchi
Visit the place on the north bank of the Thames where kings were crowned and royal family members held weddings

Normally just open to the race drivers and racing teams, we ‘ll give you a detailed guided tour of this fascinating circuit from the inside. globaltix_product_data.description: Inspired by the endless wonders of the deep blue ocean and the unique cultural heritage of Vietnam, the aquarium is designed to reflect traditional folklore, based on the legend of Cá Ông - the guardian god of fishermen on their sea voyages. Spanning a vast area of 9,094 square meters with 67 tanks, this underwater kingdom is home to over 31,000 marine species, from adorable jellyfish to powerful sharks. Notably, you will have the chance to meet the first-ever family of California sea lions born in Vietnam! A wide range of educational and recreational activities are available, offering visitors, especially children, fascinating and insightful experiences about the ocean world. Explore the marine ecosystem with Cá Ông through AR technology, where you'll dive deep into the enchanting ocean world and uncover hidden secrets of marine creatures.
highlights: Lotte world aquarium Hanoi is a captivating underwater world with 67 large and small tanks housing 400 species and 31,000 marine creatures.
Lotte World Aquarium Hanoi offers a perfect blend of education and entertainment for all ages.
Watch as they engage with interactive displays, feeding sessions, and educational presentations designed to inspire a love for the ocean and its magnificent cre

globaltix_product_data.description: Step back into the wizarding world with Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, the internationally acclaimed stage production now captivating audiences in Tokyo. This spectacular theatrical experience continues the story of Harry Potter, set 19 years after the Battle of Hogwarts, as a new generation embarks on a magical journey filled with friendship, secrets, and unexpected twists. Performed in Japanese with breathtaking stagecraft, the Tokyo production brings the Wizarding World to life through stunning special effects, elaborate set designs, and powerful performances. From time-turning adventures to dazzling spellbinding scenes, the show delivers a theatrical experience unlike any other. Whether you are a longtime fan or discovering the story for the first time, this award-winning production offers a magical evening of drama, emotion, and unforgettable stage magic.
highlights: Follow the next chapter of Harry Potter’s story, set 19 years later
Experience spectacular special effects and magical stage illusions
Watch the internationally award-winning stage production in Tokyo
A must-see experience for Wizarding World fans and theatre lovers
Enjoy world-class performances in a purpose-built theatre setting
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission tickets can be redeemed 1 hour before the show starts. Please make sure to redeem them before the show begins. Preschool children are not permitted to enter. Strollers are prohibited. Purchase is confirmed immediately after reservation. Please use with your passport. The estimated show time is 3 hours and 40 minutes (including intermission). Entry is expected to open approximately 40 minutes before the show starts. No open drinks or flash photography allowed in the audience area. There are no coin-operated lockers or storage rooms in the venue. If you have large luggage that is difficult to bring to your seat, you may ask staff for assistance with temporary storage. For detailed seat numbers, please check the ticket on the day of exchange. No movement or changes allowed for prohibited ticket types and seats. If you need to re-enter, please present your ticket. If you require wheelchair space assistance, we can help if space is still available on the day. Wheelchair spaces are charged at S PLUS seat rates. The price difference will be collected on the day based on your original ticket type. To enhance your viewing experience, "Harry Potter and the Cursed Child" (Tokyo) offers subtitle services. The theater provides devices (smartphones) displaying English/Japanese subtitles, which can be requested directly at the theater on the day of the performance. Limited equipment available, first come first served.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Guests can take their time to discover various Harry Potter elements from the eight-film series, from Daily Prophet covers to the enigmatic Black family tapestry to the glowing purple brilliance of the Knight Bus.
globaltix_product_data.description: Guests can take their time to discover various Harry Potter elements from the eight-film series, from Daily Prophet covers to the enigmatic Black family tapestry to the glowing purple brilliance of the Knight Bus.
highlights: Immersive Magical Environments – Explore stunning, interactive spaces inspired by mysterious wizarding locations brought to life through multimedia effects.
Interactive Wand Experience – Use a specially designed wand to uncover hidden secrets, activate magical elements, and personalize your journey.
Singapore-Exclusive Zones – Discover unique installations available only at the Singapore edition of the experience.
Instagram-Worthy Moments – Capture enchanting photo opportunities in visually spectacular, themed environments.
Exclusive Merchandise & Butterbeer™ – Complete your visit with limited-edition souvenirs and the iconic wizarding drink.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Access is valid based on your ticket type. You are required to book a timeslot in advance to enter at your preferred timing. Entry may be deferred if the exhibition is at maximum capacity. Ticket allows for a single entry only. The experience is a one-way journey and re-entry is not permitted. Once redeemed, the ticket is strictly not for sale, non-exchangeable, non-refundable, and void if altered. Lost or damaged tickets will not be replaced or refunded. Item is not to be exchanged for cash or cash equivalent. Eligibility Adult ticket: Aged 13 and above. Child ticket: Aged 4–12. Attraction Access Re-entry is not allowed once you exit the experience. The exhibition owner reserves the right to remove unruly or disruptive individuals. The exhibition owner reserves the right to make changes without prior notice. Additional Information Not to be used for promotional purposes unless approved in writing by the exhibition owner. The exhibition premises are under surveillance for safety and security. By attending, you consent to being photographed, filmed, or recorded for marketing and promotional purposes. Important Notes Please take care of your safety and personal belongings at all times. The organizer is not liable (to the extent permitted by law) for any damage, injury, illness, or loss arising from your attendance. How to Get There By MRT: Take the MRT and alight at the nearest station to the venue. From there, it is just a short walk to the exhibition entrance. Follow the directional signs within the mall/venue for “Harry Potter: Visions of Magic.” By Car: Drive to the venue and park at the designated parking area. Ample parking spaces are available within the mall/complex. Follow internal signage to the exhibition hall. By Taxi / Ride-Hailing: Book a taxi or ride-hailing service and set your destination to the venue name. Use the main entrance drop-off point for the most convenient access. By Bus: Take any public bus that stops near the venue. From the bus stop, walk a few minutes to reach the attraction.

Step into an enchanting world where the wizarding universe comes to life through breathtaking visuals and immersive interactive technology. Explore iconic locations, encounter mythical creatures, and discover the artistry behind the beloved films in a spellbinding journey designed for fans of all ages. Perfect for families, friends, and groups seeking a magical adventure together. How to Get There By MRT: Take the MRT and alight at the nearest station to the venue. From there, it is just a short walk to the exhibition entrance. Follow the directional signs within the mall/venue for “Harry Potter: Visions of Magic.” By Car: Drive to the venue and park at the designated parking area. Ample parking spaces are available within the mall/complex. Follow internal signage to the exhibition hall. By Taxi / Ride-Hailing: Book a taxi or ride-hailing service and set your destination to the venue name. Use the main entrance drop-off point for the most convenient access. By Bus: Take any public bus that stops near the venue. From the bus stop, walk a few minutes to reach the attraction.
options.termsAndConditions: Admission Access is valid based on your ticket type. You are required to book a timeslot in advance to enter at your preferred timing. Once redeemed, the ticket is strictly not for sale, non-exchangeable, non-refundable, and void if altered. Lost or damaged tickets will not be replaced or refunded. Item is not to be exchanged for cash or cash equivalent.Eligibility Adult ticket: Aged 13 and above. Child ticket: Aged 4–12.Attraction Access Re-entry is not allowed once you exit the experience. By attending, you consent to being photographed, filmed, or recorded for marketing and promotional purposes.Important Notes Please take care of your safety and personal belongings at all times. The organizer is not liable (to the extent permitted by law) for any damage, injury, illness, or loss arising from your attendance.

Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass (1-Day Unlimited Speedboat Rides)

  • This ticket is valid starting from 12th December 2025
  • This ticket are valid for 3 months from the date of purchase, and prices are not guaranteed until the ticket is issued.
  • Younger children are permitted however the parent/guardian will be required to sign a liabilty waiver and comply with certain requirements.
  • Operating hours: 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM, with hourly sailings, 7 days a week.
  • Sailing times and routes are subject to weather, sea conditions, and operational requirements.
  • Guests may board the next available boat without prior reservation. Average waiting time is under 30 minutes.
  • Children are permitted; however, it is recommended that they are at least 4 years old.
  • Younger children may travel subject to a signed liability waiver and compliance with safety requirements.
  • Life jackets (including child sizes), life rings, and flotation devices are provided onboard.
  • Maximum capacity: up to 50 passengers per boat.
  • All vessels are licensed as Singapore Passenger Harbour Craft (SP) under the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore.
  • Operations continue in rainy weather.
  • In the event of expected thunderstorms or unsafe conditions, the Captain may suspend sailings until conditions improve.
  • The ride is generally smooth; however, occasional bumps may occur due to vessel wakes and sea conditions.
  • Guests who are prone to motion sickness are advised to take appropriate medication prior to boarding.
  • Boats do not have toilet facilities. Guests are advised to use nearby restrooms before boarding.
  • Guests may experience light splashes depending on seating and weather; complimentary raincoats are available upon request.
  • Music and videos about local landmarks may be played during the cruise.
  • Pets are not permitted onboard.
  • Smoking is strictly prohibited on all vessels.

Open date ticket are valid for 3 months from date of issue

  • 1.1.3 Super Peak- Super Peak ticket holder grants flexibility to gain admission all days.
  • 1.2 You are required to book a timeslot in advance so that you can enter the Experience venue at your preferred timing. Otherwise, you might be asked to return for a later timing if the Experience is operating at maximum capacity.
  • 1.3 Ticket is valid for (Age is calculated according to date of birth)
  • 1.3. 1 Adult aged 13 and above.
  • 1.3.2 Child aged 4-12.
  • 1.3.2.1 Children must always be accompanied by an adult. The accompanying adult/ guardian acknowledges and agrees to these ticket and admission terms and conditions.
  • 1.4 Harry Potter: Visions of Magic Experience operating hours are subject to change without prior notice. Guests may visit https://harrypottervisionsofmagic.com/sg/ for updates prior to visit.
  • 1.5 Ticket allows for ONE single entry where the Experience is a one-way journey, and guests will not be allowed to re-enter the Experience.
  • 1.5 Lost or damaged ticket(s) will not be replaced or refunded.

Venture behind the scenes to discover a huge array of fantastic sets, costumes, and...
globaltix_product_data.description: Perfect for those with a penchant for Harry Potter, this Warner Bros. Studio Tour in London provides a unique opportunity to explore the magic of the Harry Potter films — the most successful movie series of all time. Venture behind the scenes to discover a huge array of fantastic sets, costumes, and props. Learn some closely guarded secrets, including facts about the special effects and animatronics that made the Harry Potter films so hugely popular around the world. Step onto the famous cobblestones of Diagon Alley, featuring the shopfronts of Ollivander's Wand Shop, Flourish and Blotts, and Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes. See iconic props from the films, including Harry’s Nimbus 2000 and Hagrid’s motorcycle. Rediscover other memorable sets from the film series, including the Gryffindor common room, the boys’ dormitory, Hagrid’s hut, and the Potions classroom. Visit Platform 9 ¾ and ride the Hogwarts Express! Explore a perfect recreation of the platform and the train itself and relive the magic of Harry’s trips to Hogwarts by posing with a luggage trolley right before it disappears through the wall and walking through the train carriage. Learn how the iconic train scenes were filmed, and browse through your favorite character’s luggage! Top off your Hogwarts Express adventure in a train-themed souvenir shop and load up on goodies inspired by your favorite Potter films. For the first time ever, enter the set of Gringotts Wizarding Bank! Walk through the wizarding bank of Gringott's, the Lestrange vault, a gallery of goblins, and much more. Admire the imposing marble columns and discover the costumes and prosthetics belonging to Bogrod, Griphook, and many other Goblin bankers. Then enter the depths of the Lestrange vault used to store the treasures of Bellatrix Lestrange and surround yourselves with treasure. You'll have approximately 4 hours to enjoy the magic of the Harry Potter studio. Due to heavy traffic at busier times of the year, this may be shorter however the minimum time spent at the studio will be no less than 4 hours. With the bus journey included, the total duration of the tour is normally 7–7.5 hours, subject to traffic and entry times. Dark Arts: 12th September – 9th November Back by popular demand is Dark Arts, the Studio Tour’s eerie Hallowe’en feature. The Great Hall will have over 100 pumpkins magically floating above the Hogwarts house tables, dressed with a Hallowe’en feast. Dementors and Death Eaters will appear throughout the Studio Tour, and costumes of Hogwarts ghosts will be on display. Hogwarts in the Snow: 15th November – 18th January Hogwarts in the Snow returns for the festive season. The Great Hall will be transformed into scenes from the Yule Ball. The Gryffindor common room, Forbidden Forest and Diagon Alley will be dressed for Christmas, and the Hogwarts castle model will be coated in snow using the same technique from the films.

globaltix_product_data.description: The world-famous Heineken® Brewery, established in 1867, continues to be a prime destination for beer enthusiasts in the heart of Amsterdam. Transformed into an interactive, semi-guided, and immersive attraction within the old brewery premises, it offers multiple tastings and complimentary beer, making it a must-visit spot for beer fans and an essential Amsterdam experience. Begin your journey at the Heineken Experience by exploring historic brewing rooms adorned with authentic 18th-century wooden and copper machinery. Engage in modern interactive games sponsored by Formula 1, UEFA Champions League, and the Rugby World Cup, showcasing Heineken's timeless appeal. Chuckle-worthy exhibits reveal unique perspectives, such as experiencing life as a beer bottle and gaining a beer's-eye view of the brewing process. Delve deeper into the brewing process by tasting, touching, and smelling the four all-natural ingredients that make up Heineken® beer, all in the spirit of scientific exploration. Conclude your visit with a small beer-tasting session during the tour, followed by two more complimentary beers at the stylish, atmospheric bar. You'll leave not only with a comprehensive understanding but also a newfound fluency in the international language of Pilsner. Audio guide: Chinese, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish Live guide: English

globaltix_product_data.description: A Feast for the Senses, Elevated Welcome to ORBIT, where culinary artistry meets unparalleled luxury. Nestled atop Kuala Lumpur Tower, our opulent dining space exudes sophistication, blending contemporary elegance with breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline. Indulge in a meticulously crafted buffet that harmonises local and international flavours, seamlessly fusing tradition with modern innovation. Whether it's an intimate dinner or a grand celebration, ORBIT offers a dining experience that is both refined and unforgettable.
highlights: Ideal for Special Occasions – Perfect for romantic dinners, celebrations, or memorable evenings with family and friends.
360° City Panorama – Experience a slowly revolving dining floor offering ever-changing views of Kuala Lumpur from above.
Revolving Sky Dining – Dine at ORBIT Revolving Dining while enjoying panoramic skyline views from the top of Kuala Lumpur Tower.
Elegant Dining Atmosphere – Enjoy a refined dining space combining contemporary design, comfort, and a premium skyline setting.
International Buffet Selection – Savor a buffet featuring Malaysian favorites and international dishes, thoughtfully prepared with modern culinary touches.

globaltix_product_data.description: Unique experiences only available at Hilton Onsen. It is one of the three mineral water springs with the highest concentration of bromine in the world. Implemented by leading Japanese architects and craftsmen, set amidst the picturesque mountains of Quang Hanh hot spring valley. 5-star quality service to enjoy Japanese standard onsen art with unique experiences. Hilton Onsen is operated by Sun Group – The leading resort investor in Vietnam. Hilton Quang Hanh Onsen is more than just relaxing, soaking in a hot mineral spring is natural treatment for your health, especially to the elderly and stressful working people: enhances the body’s resistance, regains balance from the chaos of everyday life, prevents from problems of the skin, joints, nerve pains, and wounds as well as stimulates blood circulation to regenerate a smooth and healthy new skin.
highlights: Hilton Onsen boasts one of the three mineral water springs in the world with the highest concentration of bromine
Designed and implemented by leading Japanese architects and craftsmen, Hilton Onsen offers an authentic and immersive Japanese onsen experience
Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and find serenity amidst the breathtaking beauty of Quang Hanh hot spring valley
Indulge in 5-star quality service as you enjoy unparalleled hospitality and attention to detail at Hilton Onsen

globaltix_product_data.summary: Hoi An Memories is a spectacular outdoor cultural performance held nightly on a riverside stage beside the Thu Bon River in Hoi An, Quang Nam Province. Featuring over 500 performers, the show showcases Hoi An's rich history and cultural heritage through traditional Vietnamese dance, music, elaborate...
globaltix_product_data.description: Hoi An Memories is a spectacular outdoor cultural performance held nightly on a riverside stage beside the Thu Bon River in Hoi An, Quang Nam Province. Featuring over 500 performers, the show showcases Hoi An's rich history and cultural heritage through traditional Vietnamese dance, music, elaborate choreography, visual effects, and stunning stage production. Presented across five acts, the performance tells the story of Hoi An's evolution from a historic trading port to one of Vietnam's most iconic cultural destinations. Combining immersive storytelling with impressive live performances, Hoi An Memories offers an unforgettable evening experience for visitors of all ages.
highlights: Enjoy stunning visual effects, immersive stage design, and the picturesque Thu Bon River as part of the performance setting.
Be captivated by a soundtrack that blends traditional Vietnamese music with contemporary orchestration, enhancing the show's emotional storytelling.
Spend an unforgettable evening in Hoi An with a world-class cultural performance showcasing the city's history, traditions, and artistic heritage.
Experience one of Vietnam's largest outdoor cultural performances, featuring over 500 performers on a spectacular riverside stage along the Thu Bon River.
Discover Hoi An's rich heritage through a captivating performance that traces its journey from the ancient Cham Kingdom to its thriving trading port era.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Important Information Guests are advised to arrive early to explore Hoi An Memories Land's themed areas, gardens, and cultural exhibits before the main performance begins. The venue is open-air. Guests should bring insect repellent and dress comfortably for the evening humidity typical of Central Vietnam's coastal climate. Photography and video recording for personal non-commercial use is welcome. Professional equipment and flash photography during the show may be restricted. Food and beverages are available at on-site outlets within Hoi An Memories Land before the show. Outside food and drinks may not be permitted inside the seating area. The performance includes fire effects, loud percussion, and dramatic lighting sequences. Guests with sensory sensitivities should consider this before attending.

globaltix_product_data.summary: As the first themed cultural park in Vietnam, Hoi An Impression Theme Park employs diversity in architecture and artistry, reflecting the vibrant life of a bustling international port in the 16th and 17th centuries. Drawing inspiration from the architecture and cultural-historical tales of Hoi An, H...
globaltix_product_data.description: As the first themed cultural park in Vietnam, Hoi An Impression Theme Park employs diversity in architecture and artistry, reflecting the vibrant life of a bustling international port in the 16th and 17th centuries. Drawing inspiration from the architecture and cultural-historical tales of Hoi An, Hoi An Impression Theme Park vividly re-creates the bustling portrait of Faifo trading port in the midst of the 16th-17th centuries. When visiting Impressions of Hoi An Theme Park, travellers are not only captivated by the cultural ambiance within each zone: Vietnamese Village, Japanese Village, Chinese Village, or the Thien Duc Spiritual Area, but also enthralled by lively interactive mini-shows, offering a closer glimpse into the life, people, and culture of Hoi An during its glorious past.
highlights: World’s Largest Outdoor Show: Watch over 500 performers bring 400 years of Hoi An’s history to life on a massive open-air stage by the Thu Bon River.
Cultural Storytelling: Experience Vietnam’s heritage through music, dance, traditional costumes, and dramatic visual storytelling.
Immersive Island Setting: Enter Hoi An Impression Theme Park, a cultural island recreating historical architecture and vibrant local scenes.
Spectacular Night Performance: Enjoy impressive lighting, sound, and stage effects that transform the riverside stage into a living historical panorama.
Iconic Vietnam Experience: Discover one of Vietnam’s most famous cultural shows celebrating the legacy of Hoi An.

globaltix_product_data.name: Hoi An Memories Show
globaltix_product_data.summary: Hoi An Memories is a spectacular outdoor cultural performance held nightly on a riverside stage beside the Thu Bon River in Hoi An, Quang Nam Province. Featuring over 500 performers, the show showcases Hoi An's rich history and cultural heritage through traditional Vietnamese dance, music, elaborate...
globaltix_product_data.description: Hoi An Memories is a spectacular outdoor cultural performance held nightly on a riverside stage beside the Thu Bon River in Hoi An, Quang Nam Province. Featuring over 500 performers, the show showcases Hoi An's rich history and cultural heritage through traditional Vietnamese dance, music, elaborate choreography, visual effects, and stunning stage production. Presented across five acts, the performance tells the story of Hoi An's evolution from a historic trading port to one of Vietnam's most iconic cultural destinations. Combining immersive storytelling with impressive live performances, Hoi An Memories offers an unforgettable evening experience for visitors of all ages.
highlights: Enjoy stunning visual effects, immersive stage design, and the picturesque Thu Bon River as part of the performance setting.
Be captivated by a soundtrack that blends traditional Vietnamese music with contemporary orchestration, enhancing the show's emotional storytelling.
Spend an unforgettable evening in Hoi An with a world-class cultural performance showcasing the city's history, traditions, and artistic heritage.
Experience one of Vietnam's largest outdoor cultural performances, featuring over 500 performers on a spectacular riverside stage along the Thu Bon River.
Discover Hoi An's rich heritage through a captivating performance that traces its journey from the ancient Cham Kingdom to its thriving trading port era.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Important Information Guests are advised to arrive early to explore Hoi An Memories Land's themed areas, gardens, and cultural exhibits before the main performance begins. The venue is open-air. Guests should bring insect repellent and dress comfortably for the evening humidity typical of Central Vietnam's coastal climate. Photography and video recording for personal non-commercial use is welcome. Professional equipment and flash photography during the show may be restricted. Food and beverages are available at on-site outlets within Hoi An Memories Land before the show. Outside food and drinks may not be permitted inside the seating area. The performance includes fire effects, loud percussion, and dramatic lighting sequences. Guests with sensory sensitivities should consider this before attending.

options.description: To celebrate MOLLY's 20th anniversary, from January 18, 2026 to March 31, 2026, the Peak Tram and Peak Tower, together with POP MART and Peak Plaza, will present..."MOLLY's Star-Seeking Journey: Back to Victoria Peak" eventThis project reviews MOLLY's creative evolution over the past 20 years and invites fans worldwide to travel through a time tunnel, embark on an immersive journey, relive classic MOLLY moments, and create new memories under the starlight. In 2006, Kenny was invited to participate in a fundraising event at Victoria Peak to paint for children, where he encountered his muse: a lovely little girl who inspired his creativity, leading to the birth of Molly. Every year, Molly receives a special gift: a commemorative sculpture specially designed by his creator, Kenny Wong. Each sculpture is like a tiny mark on a timeline, protecting Molly and witnessing his every step of growth. To celebrate Molly's 20th anniversary, let Molly return to its birthplace, Victoria Peak, to savor and appreciate everything about Hong Kong and rediscover the joy of childhood. For safety reasons, children under 1 year old, seniors over 70 years old, and pregnant women are not eligible for booking. 3. The sleeping area is located in Adventure Isle Aquarium or Dolphin Pavilion (Ocean Exploration Pavilion) (no partitions). Each paying guest will be provided with a single mattress, sheet, pillow, and a set of bedding. 4. The sleeping area is primarily for online booking. (All exhibition halls will turn off their lights during nighttime sleeping hours.) 5. The shower area provides body wash, shampoo, and hair dryers. To support environmental protection, please bring your own bath towels, towels, toothbrushes, toothpaste, slippers, and other personal items (these are not sold on-site). 6. No late-night snacks are provided in the park. Please prepare your own food and supplies if needed. Thank you. 7. Pets are not allowed in the park. For guests participating in overnight stays, to ensure animal safety and health, please arrange for your beloved pets to stay at a pet hotel or leave them with family or friends. 8. Dinner and breakfast arrangements may be adjusted based on on-site operations and event attendance. 9. The above photos or videos are for illustration purposes only. Please refer to the actual on-site operations. Location of use Ticket center at the 5th floor entrance of Farglory Ocean Park Time of use 09:00~13:30(Please arrive by 1:30 PM on the day of the activity.)
howToUse: Show Mobile Ticket: At Redemption Counter
无需取票，凭电子凭证直接验证使用
使用地址：远雄海洋公园 5楼入口处验票中心
使用时间：09:00~13:30(请于活动当天13:30前抵达)
补充说明：1. 将于入住日5天前会发行前通知信，请凭行前通知信至现场兑换；2. 请于活动当天13:30前抵达，报到领取识别证，并先前往互动中心放置行李
Present your E-voucher for direct verification and access.
inclusions: · Service description: 2-Day Park Admission Ticket; One night stay; Dinner on Day 1; Day 2 Breakfast; Chinese guided tour; Animal celebrity photo; Ocean experience (depending on the package selected when registering - aquarium version or capybara version)
Free for children aged 1–3 (meals and bedding not provided; only toiletries and ID card included)
exclusions: Bath towel, face towel, toothbrush and toothpaste, slippers
cancellationNotes:
If a cancellation request is submitted before 11:59 PM, 3 day(s) prior to the date of use, no cancellation fee will be charged.
If a cancellation request is submitted before 11:59 PM 1 day(s) before the date of use, a fee of 50% will be charged.

By sailing between the Puxi and Pudong banks, you witness a stunning visual dialogue between the 19th-century colonial elegance of The Bund and the neon-lit, futuristic skyscrapers of Lujiazui. Whether viewed under the morning sun or during the spectacular nightly light show, the cruise provides a panoramic perspective of the "Museum of Buildings" and the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower that simply cannot be matched from the shore
highlights: See the "Museum of Buildings" on the west bank. This row of 52 colonial-era structures showcases stunning Art Deco and Gothic architecture from Shanghai’s earl
Witness the world’s most futuristic skyline on the east bank. You’ll get a clear view of the Shanghai Tower and the World Financial Center towering over the riv
Get an up-close look at this iconic landmark. Its unique "pearl" design and colorful LED displays make it the most recognizable silhouette in the city.
The best part is the nighttime illumination. At 7:00 PM, the buildings light up, turning the river into a glowing reflection of gold and neon
The cruise shows you "old" and "new" Shanghai at once. It’s the only spot where you can see the 19th-century history and 21st-century future side-by-side.

globaltix_product_data.description: There was a time when master painter Rembrandt van Rijn ran the Netherlands largest painting studio here. Then he lost it all to bankruptcy. Now it's a museum where you can experience etchings and sketches by the great artist, in the place where he made them. Until 12 February, you can see , Rembrandt’s earliest known paintings. They're on display together in the Netherlands for the first time ever.Between 1639 and 1658, Rembrandt lived and worked in this beautiful house. The Rembrandt House now owns the virtually complete collection of Rembrandt’s etchings, and part of this collection is permanently shown in the exhibition gallery here. In addition, there are changing temporary exhibitions that show works of his predecessors and contemporaries, as well as a collection of Rembrandt’s possessions, including military helmets and weaponry, Roman busts and seashells. The modern wing of the museum holds modern and current works of art. Perhaps the coolest thing about a visit here is the fact that the house has been redecorated with furniture, art and objects dating from the 17th century. So you can get that original feeling. options.description: Voucher Type: Mobile QR Code Voucher. Redemption Process: You do not need to print anything. Simply go directly to the security and main ticket scanner gate of Beylerbeyi Palace. Open your smartphone, show your official QR code ticket voucher sent via the platform, scan it at the turnstile, and enter immediately. Audio Guide Activation: Along with your ticket, you will receive an online download link or app instructions. Open the link on your phone, select your preferred language, and plug in your personal earphones to start the self-guided audio tour as you walk through the palace.
options.termsAndConditions: Meeting Point: Please do not go directly to the main ticket window. You must meet your local host at the specified meeting location (usually near the Dolmabahce Clock Tower/Cafe) at least 15 minutes before your time slot. Look for a host holding a specific flag or sign. Meeting point .Dolmabahce Palace & Harem Skip-the-Line Entry & Audio Guide Dolmabahce & Yildiz Palaces Combo Entry Opening Hours: Daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Please note that the palace complex is strictly closed on Mondays. Audio Guide Security: The official palace audio guide application requires your smartphone. Please ensure your phone is fully charged and that you bring your own personal earphones/headphones. Security & Dress Code: All visitors must pass through a mandatory airport-style security checkpoint. Large luggage, tripods, and professional video equipment are not allowed inside. Casual respectful clothing is fine, but protective shoe covers (provided free) must be worn indoors. Photography Rule: To preserve the historic art, crystal chandeliers, and gold-leaf ceilings, taking photos or videos inside the palace rooms is strictly prohibited.

globaltix_product_data.description: Enjoy a great day out on the water watching dolphins and admiring crystal clear water in this dolphin cruise from Jervis Bay! The Dolphin Eco Tour in Jervis Bay, NSW gives you the chance to see over 100 Bottlenose Dolphins all the while spending an exceptional day out on the water. Fall in love as you watch them feed in pods on the local reef systems, or catch them swimming and racing over 100-metres to play on the bow of the vessel. Keep your eyes peeled, because you may also see Sea Turtles, Whales, Sea Eagles, and Australian Fur Seals. Enjoy the history commentary as you travel amongst the untouched beaches and pristine clear waters of the area. Jervis Bay is one of the most healthy ecosystems in all of Australia, making it an ideal place to view the beloved Bottlenose Dolphin. If you're looking for a day out as a family, then this trip is perfect! Book today.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The JR Haruka Kansai Airport Express is the fastest and most direct rail connection between Kansai International Airport (KIX) and the major cities of the Kansai region — Tennoji, Osaka, Shin-Osaka, and Kyoto — making it a top choice for travelers heading into the city immediately after landing. globaltix_product_data.description: The JR Haruka Kansai Airport Express is the fastest and most direct rail connection between Kansai International Airport (KIX) and the major cities of the Kansai region — Tennoji, Osaka, Shin-Osaka, and Kyoto — making it a top choice for travelers heading into the city immediately after landing. The limited express train covers the KIX-to-Kyoto route in approximately 75 minutes, with departures roughly every 30 minutes from Kansai Airport Station. Designed with comfort in mind, the Haruka features reclining, 180-degree rotating seats (allowing groups to face each other or all face the direction of travel), dedicated luggage storage space, and onboard Wi-Fi. Green Class (First Class) carriages are available at the front of the train for travelers seeking extra comfort. Some services run as the specially decorated Hello Kitty Haruka, a popular option among visitors. For 2026, the ticket is available as a WEST QR E-Ticket, allowing travelers to skip station ticket queues entirely and board using just a QR code on their smartphone, in addition to the traditional physical ticket redeemable at green ticket machines. This discounted one-way ticket is exclusively available to travelers holding a foreign passport with Temporary Visitor status, and cannot be used by Japanese nationals or permanent residents.
highlights: Book online and receive tickets immediately for hassle-free boarding
Minimize travel fatigue with quick connections to Kyoto, Osaka, and more
Bundle with popular attraction passes for added convenience.

globaltix_product_data.description: The JR Hokkaido Rail Pass is a ticket that provides unlimited access to the JR railway network in the Hokkaido region of Japan. With this pass, travelers can explore Hokkaido's diverse landscapes, vibrant cities, and cultural attractions without limitations on the number of journeys. It's an ideal choice for tourists seeking convenient and cost-effective transportation while experiencing the beauty and charm of Hokkaido.
highlights: Enjoy cost savings, flexibility in travel, and hassle-free access to various attractions across Hokkaido.
JR Hokkaido Rail Pass offers unlimited access to the JR railway network throughout the Hokkaido region of Japan.
Explore Hokkaido's stunning landscapes, charming cities, and renowned tourist destinations with ease and convenience.

options.description: Important notice — Eid Al-Adha shipping delays Last shipment date The last shipment will be made on May 26, 2026. Shipping suspension period Shipping services will be on hold from May 27 – June 1, 2026 due to the Eid Al-Adha holiday. Resumption of services Shipping will gradually resume from June 2, 2026 and return to normal shortly after. Booking Guidelines: The name, and country of residence entered when booking must be an exact match to the passports used when boarding You must book your JR Hokkaido Rail Pass before traveling to or entering Japan. It is recommended to book the JR Pass at least 2 weeks before your trip to Japan. The date selected on the calendar is not the date of activation, but the date you intend to leave for Japan. Once purchased, you will receive an Exchange Order. You will receive one Exchange Order per person. Exchange physical vouchers (not e-tickets) You have 90 days from the Exchange Order’s issuance date to swap the Exchange Order for the actual, physical JR West Kansai in Japan at an Official Exchange Office. Once exchanged in Japan, you have 30 days to activate your JR Pass and start travelling on the trains. If you book for over 90 days in advance, the booking will not instantly confirm. You will receive your Exchange Order within 90 days before your planned visit date to Japan. Pass Eligibility: Valid only for non-Japanese passport holders with a "Temporary Visitor" Visa stamp on the passport. Non-Japanese passport holders with a permanent residence in Japan cannot use this product. Secure a Temporary Visitor Stamp at immigration to be eligible for a JR Pass. Do not pass through the automated gates, as no stamp will be applied. Japanese passport holders who have been residing outside of Japan for 10+ years are eligible to use a JR West if they have 1) a valid Japanese passport and 2) a Copy of Overseas Residential Registration/Certificate of Overseas Residence from the Japanese embassy or legation of Japan in your foreign country of residence. Visit the official website for more information about JR West eligibility.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience the region’s breathtaking natural scenery with your North Kyushu Pass. Stop by the magnificent Mount Aso, one of the world’s largest active volcanoes. Take a dip at the famous Beppu hot springs, famous for their healing properties. Spend time learning about the history of Japan in Nagasak...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the region’s breathtaking natural scenery with your North Kyushu Pass. Stop by the magnificent Mount Aso, one of the world’s largest active volcanoes. Take a dip at the famous Beppu hot springs, famous for their healing properties. Spend time learning about the history of Japan in Nagasaki. A visit to the city is never complete without strolling through Nagasaki Peace Park to look back on significant historical events. Immerse yourself in Japan’s ancient culture and history with your South Kyushu Pass. Visit the Chiran Samurai District in Kagoshima, and gain insight into the stories of these ancient warriors. Step back in time as you explore the historic feudal town of Kumamoto. Visit the charming Yakushima Island, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Explore the Obi Castle Town, Kirishima Factory Garden, the gorgeous waterfalls and shrines in Miyazaki. To get the best of both worlds and a comprehensive itinerary, opt for the Kyushu All Area Pass. Discover Japan’s beautiful southern islands with your JR Kyushu Rail Pass.
highlights: Capture moments in ancient ceramic towns, stunning shrines, vibrant cities, and secluded islands
Marvel at the grandiosity of Mount Aso, the largest active volcano in Japan
Easily travel around Kyushu with unlimited use of Japan's rail network for three or five days
inclusions: Southern Kyushu: Kumamoto, Misumi, Hitoyoshi, Kirishima-onsen, Kirishima-jingū, Kagoshima, Ibusuki, Nishi-Ōyama, Miyazaki, Obi, Nangō and Nobeoka（Shinkansen rides allowed between Kumamoto and Kagoshima-chuo.）

globaltix_product_data.summary: JR Tower Observatory T38 sits atop JR Tower in Sapporo, Hokkaido — directly connected to JR Sapporo Station and standing as the tallest building in Hokkaido at 173 meters. Located on the 38th floor, 160 meters above the city, the observation deck offers uninterrupted 360-degree panoramic views of Sa...
globaltix_product_data.description: JR Tower Observatory T38 sits atop JR Tower in Sapporo, Hokkaido — directly connected to JR Sapporo Station and standing as the tallest building in Hokkaido at 173 meters. Located on the 38th floor, 160 meters above the city, the observation deck offers uninterrupted 360-degree panoramic views of Sapporo through floor-to-ceiling glass windows. Visitors can take in natural landmarks such as Mount Maruyama, Mount Okura, and Mount Teine, alongside urban sights like Odori Park and Susukino. On clear days, distant mountains including Yubaridake and Ashibetsudake are visible on the horizon. The deck transforms with the seasons and time of day — offering sunlit cityscapes by day and Sapporo's glittering skyline by night, including views of trains arriving and departing from JR Sapporo Station below. The observatory is designed as an immersive experience beyond just the view, featuring artwork, indirect lighting, and ambient music throughout the space. Guests can also relax at T'CAFE, located within the observation room, offering coffee, smoothies, cakes, and light meals, or browse the on-site souvenir shop for original merchandise.

globaltix_product_data.description: Defy gravity here at Jump Street Asia! Welcome to Malaysia's biggest trampoline park, with over 34,000 square feet of trampolines at the heart of the Klang Valley. It is also home to 6 Olympic-grade trampolines! It's definitely not a place to be missed! Opened since 2014, Jump Street Asia have brought smiles to people of all ages. We cater to events such as birthday parties, school trips, corporate team building and many more! After your visit here, somebody's gotta pick up a few tricks or two right?
highlights: Jump, Tap & Score: Test your reflexes and response! The highest points win.
High Performance: Prepare for a show! Watch the coach pull tricks.
Street Soccer: In case you’re bored of trampolines, let’s play a friendly game of football.
Zipline: Take flight at Zipline! An attraction we’re all waiting for.
inclusions: High Performance area featuring six Olympic-spec trampolines
Main Court, nearly 10,000 sq.ft. of interconnected trampolines
Three vertical running Walls of different height

Stictly NO CHANGES on booking time or date. Tickets purchased are strictly NON REFUNDABLE. Tickets purchased are NOT including grip socks. All jumpers MUST wear grip socks on the trampoline. All jumpers MUST complete waiver and liability form before jumping session which is available in here. In line with the new Government regulation, starting 1st August 2020 face masks during check-in are MANDATORY except while Jumping Activity
globaltix_product_data.address: 8A, Jalan 13/6, Pjs 13, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia

options.name: Admission Ticket
options.description: Kindly check your preferred jumping sessions either morning, afternoon, or evening session before purchase. All jumpers MUST arrive 30 minutes before the jumping session starts. So please arrive on time to avoid disappointment. Children below age 12 are NOT allowed to book the tickets on their own. Operating Hours / Schedule Jump Street Asia is open Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM. It is closed every Monday. There are 4 jumping sessions per day: Morning: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM Midday: 12:10 PM – 2:10 PM Afternoon: 2:20 PM – 4:20 PM Evening: 4:30 PM – 6:30 PM Duration: Each session is approximately 2 hours. How To Get There Address: No. 8A, Jalan 13/6, Seksyen 13, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor — right next door to Jaya One Mall, after Cold Storage and behind the Bosch Building. By Car: Accessible via the Federal Highway, SPRINT Highway, or LDP Highway. Ample parking is available at the venue. By LRT: Nearest LRT stations are Asia Jaya and Universiti. From there, take a Grab or taxi to the park. By Shuttle Bus: A complimentary shuttle bus runs from Taman Jaya LRT station every hour from 10 AM to 6 PM on weekends and public holidays. By Grab/Taxi: Available throughout KL and PJ for a direct drop-off.
